cach_cuc_doi_thuong.dao_hoa_pham_chu: You're charismatic, good with people and have many small talents; your love and social life is rich, so keep a sense of measure.

cach_cuc_doi_thuong.nhat_chieu_loi_mon: You're energetic and outgoing, and usually flourish early in life; keep the momentum going with steady learning.

cach_cuc_doi_thuong.nhat_nguyet_chieu_bich: You're blessed with home, land and accumulated property; keep the peace at home and the wealth lasts longer.

cach_cuc_doi_thuong.van_luong_chan_ky: You're upright, principled and measured in what you say; you suit the role of adviser, teacher or assessor.

cach_cuc_doi_thuong.song_loc_giap_menh: You easily benefit from your family, relatives or surroundings and rarely go short; use that to do bigger things.
cach_cuc_doi_thuong.tai_loc_giap_ma: The more you travel and trade, the more easily money comes; work that involves a lot of moving around suits you.
cach_cuc_doi_thuong.quy_tinh_giap_menh: People in strong positions often notice and support you; keep your word and do your part well to keep that trust.
cach_cuc_doi_thuong.quyen_sat_hoa_loc: You're tough, have been through many hardships and turned pressure into credibility; remember to be gentle with the people close to you.

cach_cuc_doi_thuong.dong_luong_dan_than: You're gentle, often help people and suit caring or service work; set clear goals and your kindness turns into results.
cach_cuc_doi_thuong.liem_tuong_dong_cung: You're serious, keep your word and work by principle; a touch more softness makes it easier for others to follow you.

cach_cuc_doi_thuong.tu_vi_co_quan: You have your own views and are used to carrying things yourself; finding one or two trustworthy partners takes you much further.
cach_cuc_doi_thuong.hoa_ky_thien_di: When you travel or work with strangers, small hitches and misunderstandings come easily; preparing papers and schedules carefully and agreeing terms clearly from the start keeps things calm.

cach_cuc_doi_thuong.cu_hoa_duong: You tend to bottle up irritation, and words can get heated; letting off stress regularly and sleeping on anything annoying before you speak is how you keep the peace.

cach_cuc_doi_thuong.loc_ton_thu_than: The older you get, the better you are at keeping wealth and staying financially steady; starting a long-term saving plan early makes this clearer.
cach_cuc_doi_thuong.thien_ma_menh_di: You're active, often on the move and suited to work involving travel and trade; choose trips with a clear purpose and every one of them pays off.
cach_cuc_doi_thuong.khoa_quyen_hoi_menh: You have credibility and a firm grip on things, and are easily given responsibility; state the value of your work clearly so your income keeps up with your reputation.
cach_cuc_doi_thuong.co_nguyet_dong_luong_ba: You're thoughtful, like stability and suit specialist work within an organisation; every few years, set yourself a new step forward so you don't stand still.

Mệnh.tuan: You often succeed later than your peers; the ability is there, but it takes a few tries before others recognise it.
Mệnh.triet: When young, you often had to start over because plans were cut off halfway; the older you get, the more firmly you stand on your own.
Mệnh.loi_khuyen: Set goals in three-year stretches instead of comparing yourself with friends year by year, and note what you've achieved after each stretch.
Mệnh.loi_khuyen_triet: When a plan gets cut off, write down what you learned and start again soon — don't wait for perfect conditions.

Huynh Đệ.tuan: Your siblings are rarely able to help right when you need it; the bond grows clearer once everyone is grown up with families of their own.
Huynh Đệ.triet: When you were young, you and your siblings were often apart or each went their own way; you grow closer later.
Huynh Đệ.loi_khuyen: Don't wait for your siblings to reach out; call once a month just to chat, not to ask for anything.
Huynh Đệ.loi_khuyen_triet: Keep in touch with your siblings through a fixed yearly get-together, even when you live far apart.

Phu Thê.tuan: Love tends to come late for you, or only after one or two relationships; the longer a relationship lasts, the stronger it gets.
Phu Thê.triet: Your early relationships tend to stop halfway because of circumstances rather than lost feelings; later ones are usually steadier.
Phu Thê.loi_khuyen: Don't rush to marry to beat the clock; know each other long enough to see how they handle one argument and one money shortage.
Phu Thê.loi_khuyen_triet: When a relationship ends, give yourself a few months to see what you really need before starting a new one.

Tử Nữ.tuan: Children tend to come later than planned, or your child is slow to show their abilities but progresses steadily later on.
Tử Nữ.triet: The early years of raising children can be unsettled, like sending them away or changing schools often; it calms down as they grow.
Tử Nữ.loi_khuyen: Compare your child with themselves a year ago, not with other people's children; keep one session a week just for playing together.
Tử Nữ.loi_khuyen_triet: When you have to change schools or carers, give your child time to adjust and keep routines at home the same.

Tài Bạch.tuan: Your money comes slowly: raises arrive late, payments are often overdue; on the other hand, money you've kept doesn't drain away easily.
Tài Bạch.triet: When young, your income was often interrupted or stuck in one place; from middle age money becomes steadier.
Tài Bạch.loi_khuyen: Always keep enough to live on for three months, and never budget around money that hasn't reached your account yet.
Tài Bạch.loi_khuyen_triet: Don't rely on a single source of income; have at least one side income or a separate reserve.

Tật Ách.tuan: Your body recovers slowly: after a tiring spell, you take longer than others to get your strength back.
Tật Ách.triet: When young, your daily rhythm was often broken by study, work and irregular late nights; keep good habits later and your stamina grows.
Tật Ách.loi_khuyen: After every intense stretch, give yourself a day or two of real rest, and keep your yearly check-up.
Tật Ách.loi_khuyen_triet: Keep a fixed bedtime even in exam season or busy periods; have a check-up once a year.

Thiên Di.tuan: Your trips away and changes of scene tend to start slowly: paperwork takes time, and you need time to settle in.
Thiên Di.triet: When young, you often had to postpone or change plans to study or work somewhere else.
Thiên Di.loi_khuyen: Sort out paperwork and housing at least a month ahead, and give yourself three months to settle before judging a new place.
Thiên Di.loi_khuyen_triet: Always have a plan B for a trip or a move, and keep your papers ready.

Nô Bộc.tuan: You find a trustworthy circle of friends and colleagues fairly late; real helpers usually arrive after you've managed on your own a few times.
Nô Bộc.triet: Your friend groups and teams when young often broke up halfway; later you choose people more carefully and keep them longer.
Nô Bộc.loi_khuyen: Do a small project together before inviting anyone to invest or go into a big venture with you.
Nô Bộc.loi_khuyen_triet: When a group breaks up, stay in touch with the best one or two people from it; they often help you later.

Quan Lộc.tuan: You rise more slowly than your ability deserves: you do good work but wait a long time for recognition, and grow steadier with time.
Quan Lộc.triet: When young, your work was often interrupted — projects stopped, employers changed hands, careers had to change; it settles into one direction from middle age.
Quan Lộc.loi_khuyen: Choose one main specialism and build on it steadily; update your CV once a year so you're never caught off guard by a change.
Quan Lộc.loi_khuyen_triet: Each time you change jobs, keep one core skill you can take with you, so you never start from zero.

Điền Trạch.tuan: Home matters tend to come through late for you: buying, renovating or transferring ownership all take longer than planned.
Điền Trạch.triet: When young, you often had to move or had no fixed place to live; you settle in one place later.
Điền Trạch.loi_khuyen: When buying a home, add three months and a reserve to your plan; don't transfer the full amount until the paperwork is done.
Điền Trạch.loi_khuyen_triet: While you still have to move around, choose compact, portable belongings; there's no rush to buy a home.

Phúc Đức.tuan: Peace of mind comes late for you: restless when young, you learn what makes you happy as you get older.
Phúc Đức.triet: In your early years you could rarely rely on family ways or relatives, and had to find your own source of inner support.
Phúc Đức.loi_khuyen: Keep a small habit of your own, like reading, walking or gardening, and do it even on busy days.
Phúc Đức.loi_khuyen_triet: Create your own rituals, like a weekend meal or a get-together with old friends, as a source of inner support.

Phụ Mẫu.tuan: Help from parents or mentors tends to come late; during your school years you often had to fend for yourself more than your friends did.
Phụ Mẫu.triet: When you were young, you were often away from your parents or got little guidance from them; your paperwork and procedures often had to be redone too.
Phụ Mẫu.loi_khuyen: Take the initiative to seek advice from people further along, and keep copies of all important documents in one place.
Phụ Mẫu.loi_khuyen_triet: Find someone further along to consult when choosing a school or a job, and do your paperwork ahead of deadlines.

Phu Thê.y: The older you get, the more your life revolves around your partner: big decisions start with thinking of them.
Phu Thê.loi_khuyen: Discuss a five-year plan for the two of you, and keep a part of your life that you decide on yourself.

Tài Bạch.y: The older you get, the more energy you put into earning and keeping money; you feel most at ease when there's a surplus in your account.
Tài Bạch.loi_khuyen: Set a figure that's enough for each year; once you reach it, give time to your health and your family.

Quan Lộc.y: The older you get, the more your work becomes a core part of who you are; a long break from work easily leaves you feeling empty.
Quan Lộc.loi_khuyen: Start a hobby or a circle of friends outside work now, so retirement won't feel empty later.

Thiên Di.y: The older you get, the more you live out in the world: travelling and meeting new people make you feel useful.
Thiên Di.loi_khuyen: Keep a fixed home base to rest in after each trip, and share your travel plans with your family.

Phúc Đức.y: The older you get, the more you value peace of mind and family ways over money or fame.
Phúc Đức.loi_khuyen: Make time to keep family traditions, such as memorial days and telling old stories to the younger generation, and keep a hobby of your own.

Mệnh.y: Your Body and Life palaces sit together: who you are changes little with age, and your strengths and pitfalls stay with you for life.
Mệnh.loi_khuyen: Know one of your pitfalls clearly, and set up a way to remind yourself when it shows up again.

Mệnh.kinh_da: When you feel a head-on argument coming, stop and ask yourself: will this still matter in a week?
Mệnh.hoa_linh: When you get heated, wait ten minutes before replying to a message or making a decision.
Mệnh.khong_kiep: For big plans, always have a plan B and don't put all your capital in one place.

Huynh Đệ.kinh_da: If you disagree with your siblings, say it straight out once rather than letting it drag on for months.
Huynh Đệ.hoa_linh: When you're annoyed with your siblings, text less — meeting face to face works better.
Huynh Đệ.khong_kiep: Don't take out loans or act as guarantor for your siblings until you've worked out that you could bear the loss.

Phu Thê.kinh_da: When things are tense between you, each say one thing you need, without bringing up the past.
Phu Thê.hoa_linh: Set one small rule: no big discussions when one of you is tired or hungry.
Phu Thê.khong_kiep: Keep a joint savings pot, and discuss every big expense in advance.

Tử Nữ.kinh_da: When your child talks back, lower your voice first and agree to continue after dinner.
Tử Nữ.hoa_linh: When you're annoyed, don't punish your child on the spot; wait until the evening to talk.
Tử Nữ.khong_kiep: Keep a separate fund for your child's education and don't use it for anything else.

Tài Bạch.kinh_da: Always put money dealings in writing, even with people you know.
Tài Bạch.hoa_linh: Don't lend or invest when you're being pressed to decide the same day.
Tài Bạch.khong_kiep: Split your money three ways: spending, reserve and investing; never touch the reserve.

Thiên Di.kinh_da: When there's friction out and about, give way a step and move on rather than arguing.
Thiên Di.hoa_linh: Leave fifteen minutes earlier than planned so you don't have to rush on the way.
Thiên Di.khong_kiep: When travelling far, split your money and papers between two places and carry copies of important documents.

Nô Bộc.kinh_da: With someone in the group you often clash with, talk directly once, ideally with a third person present.
Nô Bộc.hoa_linh: When someone in the group annoys you, write the message but wait until the next morning to send it.
Nô Bộc.khong_kiep: Only lend friends an amount your family wouldn't miss if it were lost.

Quan Lộc.kinh_da: When you disagree with a colleague, send a summary of what was agreed right after the conversation.
Quan Lộc.hoa_linh: Don't hand in your notice or reply to your boss while you're annoyed; wait one night.
Quan Lộc.khong_kiep: Learn a back-up skill so you're not caught off guard if you need to change jobs.

Điền Trạch.kinh_da: Put every property sale, purchase or renovation in a clear contract, especially with people you know.
Điền Trạch.hoa_linh: Check the wiring and gas cooker at home regularly; discuss home matters when everyone is calm.
Điền Trạch.khong_kiep: Don't transfer the full amount until the property paperwork is complete, and keep copies in two places.

Phúc Đức.kinh_da: With old matters among relatives, talk them through clearly once and leave it there — don't bring them up at every gathering.
Phúc Đức.hoa_linh: When your mind is in a muddle, write down what's worrying you and take a twenty-minute walk.
Phúc Đức.khong_kiep: Keep an inexpensive hobby, so that even when plans collapse your mind still has somewhere to rest.

Phụ Mẫu.kinh_da: When you disagree with your parents or boss, give your view with a reason and a suggestion instead of simply objecting.
Phụ Mẫu.hoa_linh: When you're annoyed with an elder, don't reply straight away; agree to talk again the next day.
Phụ Mẫu.khong_kiep: Read important papers and contracts carefully twice and keep copies.

Mệnh.y: You're easy to like, people readily offer you help, and you usually find a way out when you're stuck.
Mệnh.loi_khuyen: Each week, say yes to one small opportunity someone offers you instead of turning it down out of habit.

Huynh Đệ.y: Your siblings, or close friends who are like siblings, are a real source of help, sometimes even with money.
Huynh Đệ.loi_khuyen: Keep up a regular habit of seeing your siblings, even when you don't need anything.

Phu Thê.y: Love comes to you fairly easily; your partner tends to bring ease into your life and sometimes adds to the household income.
Phu Thê.loi_khuyen: Thank your partner for one specific thing they did this week.

Tử Nữ.y: Your children, or the younger people you guide, often make you proud and give you a lift.
Tử Nữ.loi_khuyen: Spend one session a week doing what your child enjoys, without slipping in any lessons.

Tài Bạch.y: Money comes in more easily than average, and you often have income on top of your main salary.
Tài Bạch.loi_khuyen: Every time money comes in, move a small part straight into a savings account before you spend.

Tật Ách.y: Your body bounces back fairly quickly after tiring spells, as long as you actually rest.
Tật Ách.loi_khuyen: Catch up on sleep in time instead of pushing one more day, especially after weeks of heavy work.

Thiên Di.y: You're luckier out in the world than at home: business trips, moving or meeting new people often open new doors.
Thiên Di.loi_khuyen: This month, accept one trip or one meeting outside your usual circle.

Nô Bộc.y: Friends and colleagues often pass you work, clients or business contacts.
Nô Bộc.loi_khuyen: When someone refers you, let them know how it went and thank them.

Quan Lộc.y: Your work gains momentum easily; in the right field, chances to earn more come fairly steadily.
Quan Lộc.loi_khuyen: Note which task brought the clearest results this quarter and put more energy into it.

Điền Trạch.y: You have a knack with property; settling down or saving through assets usually goes smoothly.
Điền Trạch.loi_khuyen: Set up a separate savings pot for your home and add to it every month, even if only a little.

Phúc Đức.y: You find joy in simple things easily and are often looked after by your family.
Phúc Đức.loi_khuyen: Keep one fixed way of unwinding, such as an evening walk or reading before bed.

Phụ Mẫu.y: Your parents, boss or teachers often help you, sometimes with advice, sometimes with real support.
Phụ Mẫu.loi_khuyen: Ask your parents or boss before a big decision, because they often have information you're missing.

Mệnh.y: You like deciding for yourself, you work decisively and you're easily given the lead role.
Mệnh.loi_khuyen: Before deciding for the whole group, ask one person what they think.

Huynh Đệ.y: Among your siblings, you're often the one who takes charge, or one of them has a very strong voice.
Huynh Đệ.loi_khuyen: Split household chores and family memorial duties clearly so no one carries them alone.

Phu Thê.y: You both have strong views; your partner may be very capable and used to being in charge.
Phu Thê.loi_khuyen: Agree in advance who decides what at home, so you fight less over the final word.

Tử Nữ.y: Your children have strong personalities and know early what they want, or you're fairly strict as a parent.
Tử Nữ.loi_khuyen: Let your child choose a few small things each day, like clothes or breakfast.

Tài Bạch.y: You keep a firm grip on money and are good at making your own spending and investment calls.
Tài Bạch.loi_khuyen: Set a big-spending limit; above it, sleep on the decision for one night.

Tật Ách.y: You can handle pressure for a long time, but you tend to push until you're worn out before you stop.
Tật Ách.loi_khuyen: Block fixed rest times in your work calendar and treat them like appointments you can't miss.

Thiên Di.y: Out in the world you carry authority and are easily given a leading role in new places.
Thiên Di.loi_khuyen: In a new workplace, spend the first week listening and observing before suggesting changes.

Nô Bộc.y: Some of your friends or colleagues have very strong voices, or you yourself are used to being team leader.
Nô Bộc.loi_khuyen: When you hand out tasks, give the reason and let people choose how to do them.

Quan Lộc.y: Your work suits a management role: carrying responsibility and making decisions.
Quan Lộc.loi_khuyen: Take on a task with clear responsibility and measurable results, so others can see what you can do.

Điền Trạch.y: You like running the household yourself, want the home your way and keep the property papers yourself.
Điền Trạch.loi_khuyen: Talk it over with your family before renovating or buying something big.

Phúc Đức.y: You're determined to keep the family's ways, but your mind rarely takes a rest.
Phúc Đức.loi_khuyen: Each day, keep a stretch of time with no phone and no work, just to let your mind rest.

Phụ Mẫu.y: Your parents or boss have strong voices, and at times you feel over-managed.
Phụ Mẫu.loi_khuyen: Say clearly which things you want to decide for yourself, gently and with concrete reasons.

Mệnh.y: People trust you because you speak with good grounds and act with restraint; when things get tangled, someone usually helps you sort them out.
Mệnh.loi_khuyen: Keep a steady learning habit, such as reading for half an hour every evening.

Huynh Đệ.y: Your siblings are easy-going, often praised by others, and know when to give good advice.
Huynh Đệ.loi_khuyen: When your siblings give you advice, hear them out fully before you reply.

Phu Thê.y: Your partner tends to be educated and courteous, and the two of you easily keep a good image in public.
Phu Thê.loi_khuyen: Beyond being polite in front of others, remember to speak from the heart when it's just the two of you.

Tử Nữ.y: Your children have a knack for study and easily win their teachers' affection.
Tử Nữ.loi_khuyen: Read with your child, or ask them what interesting thing they learned today.

Tài Bạch.y: Money comes through your reputation and expertise rather than through risk; when you're short, someone is usually willing to lend.
Tài Bạch.loi_khuyen: Keep clear records of income and spending, because your good name with money is precious capital.

Tật Ách.y: You tend to find good doctors and are willing to follow advice on looking after yourself.
Tật Ách.loi_khuyen: Pick one regular clinic and have a check-up every year.

Thiên Di.y: Out in the world you leave a good impression and are easily recommended and remembered.
Thiên Di.loi_khuyen: Prepare a short introduction of yourself that says clearly what you do.

Nô Bộc.y: You know many decent, knowledgeable people you can ask for advice when needed.
Nô Bộc.loi_khuyen: Each month, message a friend you haven't seen for a while.

Quan Lộc.y: Your work suits expertise, qualifications and explaining things; your name easily gets mentioned in your field.
Quan Lộc.loi_khuyen: Get one more certificate, or write up your work experience to share with newcomers.

Điền Trạch.y: Home life is settled, the paperwork is in order, and your family has a good name with the neighbours.
Điền Trạch.loi_khuyen: Keep all property papers in one place, with a separate scanned copy.

Phúc Đức.y: You feel at peace when you're learning, reading, or living within your family's decent ways.
Phúc Đức.loi_khuyen: Keep a reading corner, or one quiet session each week.

Phụ Mẫu.y: Your parents or teachers are knowledgeable people who gave you a good grounding in learning and good advice.
Phụ Mẫu.loi_khuyen: Ask your parents or an old teacher about a lesson they learned at the age you are now.

Mệnh.y: You tend to blame yourself and chase perfection, turning a matter over longer than most people.
Mệnh.loi_khuyen: When you notice yourself going round in circles, write down three things you can do right now and do one of them.

Huynh Đệ.y: Your siblings are something you think about a lot; misunderstandings over money or family matters come easily.
Huynh Đệ.loi_khuyen: Write down any money matters with your siblings clearly, even if it's just a text message.

Phu Thê.y: Love is something you take very much to heart; misunderstandings come easily from silence or not saying everything you mean.
Phu Thê.loi_khuyen: When you're angry, agree to talk again after a night's sleep instead of staying silent for days.

Tử Nữ.y: You worry a lot about your children, and sometimes the worry turns into pressure for both of you.
Tử Nữ.loi_khuyen: Each day, ask your child one open question and just listen, without rushing to advise.

Tài Bạch.y: Money is something you often worry about; unexpected expenses come up, or money arrives later than planned.
Tài Bạch.loi_khuyen: Set aside an emergency fund worth a few months of spending before investing any more.

Tật Ách.y: Your body easily signals tiredness when you're stressed, and you tend to notice every small sign.
Tật Ách.loi_khuyen: Sleep on time, eat at regular times, and have regular check-ups for peace of mind instead of guessing.

Thiên Di.y: When you travel or go somewhere new, you can feel out of place or run into hitches with papers and schedules.
Thiên Di.loi_khuyen: Prepare papers, schedule and a back-up plan carefully before every trip.

Nô Bộc.y: You easily get caught up in friends' and colleagues' affairs: helping a lot without being remembered, or being misunderstood.
Nô Bộc.loi_khuyen: Help within your means, and say so clearly when you can't.

Quan Lộc.y: Work is something you take very much to heart, and you easily feel you're not doing enough even when you try hard.
Quan Lộc.loi_khuyen: Set goals by the quarter rather than by feeling, and keep a list of what you've finished.

Điền Trạch.y: Home is something you worry about a lot: buying, repairs, paperwork or the atmosphere at home.
Điền Trạch.loi_khuyen: Keep the property paperwork clear, and talk about home matters when everyone is in a good mood.

Phúc Đức.y: Your mind rarely gets a rest; old family matters easily keep you awake at night.
Phúc Đức.loi_khuyen: Build one habit that slows your mind down, like walking, journalling or sitting quietly each evening.

Phụ Mẫu.y: Your relationship with your parents or boss is something you take to heart; a distance can grow because you think differently.
Phụ Mẫu.loi_khuyen: Call your parents regularly and tell them about everyday things, without waiting until something comes up.

thuan.luu_y: Work is going well and you're easily given more; the thing to watch is taking on too much and running out of energy.
thuan.viec: Choose one task whose results people will see and finish it fully before taking on more.

can_bang.luu_y: Work moves along steadily, but recognition comes more slowly than you'd like.
can_bang.viec: Send a short written summary of every verbal assignment and say clearly what you've done.

can_chu_dong.viec: Keep every agreement in writing, and don't commit to anything in corridor conversations.

thuan.luu_y: Love is calm; the trap is taking that calm for granted.
thuan.viec: Have one conversation a week without phones.

can_bang.luu_y: Love has its sweet moments and its clashes; understanding each other's rhythm makes things much smoother.
can_bang.viec: When things get tense, each say one thing you need, without bringing up the past.

can_chu_dong.luu_y: The two of you can misunderstand each other over things left unsaid, or over who decides the big things.
can_chu_dong.viec: Say one specific wish clearly instead of waiting for the other person to guess.

thuan.luu_y: You're close to your children and have good routines; the trap is expecting more than your child can manage.
thuan.viec: Each day, ask your child one question about something they enjoy, not about grades.

can_bang.luu_y: With your children you're attentive, but you can be stricter than you think.
can_bang.viec: Praise your child for one specific thing every week.

can_chu_dong.luu_y: Your children can weigh on your mind: school, where you live, or the gap between generations.
can_chu_dong.viec: Set aside one session a week just to listen to your child, without correcting.

thuan.luu_y: Going out and travelling far are going well; the thing to watch is getting careless when everything runs smoothly.
thuan.viec: When travelling far, leave early and carry copies of important documents.

can_bang.luu_y: Travel is normal, though schedules often change or small hitches happen along the way.
can_bang.viec: Plan your travel early, and don't drive when you're tired.

can_chu_dong.luu_y: Getting around and physical tasks are the main thing to watch: you tend to rush and to accept long trips at the last minute.
can_chu_dong.viec: Leave fifteen minutes early, don't drive when tired, and check protective gear before using it.

thuan.luu_y: Paperwork and contracts usually go smoothly; the trap is signing because you know the person.
thuan.viec: Read everything before you sign, even with family.

can_bang.luu_y: Paperwork and contracts move along evenly, but you should check them yourself rather than leaving them entirely to someone else.
can_bang.viec: Keep copies of everything you've signed in one place.

can_chu_dong.luu_y: Paperwork, contracts and dealings with outsiders can get stuck more than usual.
can_chu_dong.viec: Put every loan and every agreement in writing; don't hold anything in your name for others or sign on someone's behalf.

thuan.luu_y: Your energy is steady; the trap is working a lot and forgetting to rest when you feel well.
thuan.viec: Keep one full day off each week and have a check-up at the start of the year.

can_bang.luu_y: Your energy rises and falls with your work rhythm; lack of sleep is where it drains fastest.
can_bang.viec: Go to bed before 11 pm at least five nights a week.

can_chu_dong.luu_y: You tire more easily than you think and tend to keep your worries to yourself.
can_chu_dong.viec: Have regular health check-ups, and each month share one worry with someone close.

Tử Nữ.y: Your children are bright and easily win others' affection and support.

Tài Bạch.y: When it comes to money, there's someone to show you the way, and you're fairly good at holding on to it.

Quan Lộc.loi_khuyen: Find someone further ahead in your field and check in with them regularly.

Điền Trạch.y: Home is settled, property is easy to keep, and your family pitches in.

Phúc Đức.y: You grew up with good family habits; your mind settles easily with books or with people who understand you.
Phúc Đức.loi_khuyen: Spend time with the people who make you feel lighter.

Mệnh.y: You're quick and bold, but easily heated and apt to change your mind when pushed.
Mệnh.loi_khuyen: Before deciding anything while you're annoyed, wait one night.

Huynh Đệ.loi_khuyen: For anything you do jointly with your siblings, agree on it first and write it down clearly.

Phu Thê.loi_khuyen: Set one small rule: no big discussions when one of you is tired or hungry.

Tử Nữ.loi_khuyen: Take a breath and lower your voice before reminding your child; say what needs doing instead of criticising.

Tật Ách.loi_khuyen: Slow down when driving or doing physical work while you're in a hurry.

Nô Bộc.loi_khuyen: Keep clear boundaries at work, and talk to people directly rather than through others.

Quan Lộc.loi_khuyen: Learn a back-up skill so you're not caught off guard if you need to change jobs.

Huynh Đệ.loi_khuyen: Invite your siblings to a regular shared meal.

Tử Nữ.loi_khuyen: Teach your child how to say no and stay safe when making friends.

Tài Bạch.loi_khuyen: Set a monthly limit for parties and shopping.

Quan Lộc.loi_khuyen: Invest in how you present yourself and how you look after clients, because that's your strength.

Điền Trạch.loi_khuyen: Keep one quiet corner of the house just for yourself.

Phúc Đức.loi_khuyen: Make regular time for an artistic hobby.

Phụ Mẫu.loi_khuyen: Learn how to deal with people from your parents or boss, and ask them for introductions when needed.

ham.manh: You have self-respect and want to decide your own life, not living off others or letting anyone arrange it for you.

ham.manh: You care about your siblings' standing and want to keep the peace at home, even when something bothers you inside.

ham.loi_khuyen: Next time something upsets you with a sibling, say it plainly in one sentence, in a normal voice, instead of keeping quiet about it.

sang.manh: You choose a partner with backbone, and together you can build a proper, well-ordered family.

sang.loi_khuyen: Sit down with your partner and split three areas — housework, money and children — with one person having the final say in each.

ham.manh: You take love seriously, want a partner you can be proud of and want the relationship to last.
ham.de_vap: You easily expect your partner to match the picture in your head, then feel quietly disappointed when they don't keep up.
ham.loi_khuyen: Each week, tell your partner one specific thing you appreciate about them, even something small like cooking a meal or picking up the kids.

sang.manh: You set high expectations and know how to give your children structure, so they usually grow up with self-respect and keep their word.

sang.loi_khuyen: When your child tells you something, hear them out and ask "what do you think?" before giving your own view.

ham.manh: You love your children in a forward-worrying way, wanting them to have a solid place in life and not suffer the setbacks you did.
ham.de_vap: When you're tired and your child won't listen, you easily force things with authority instead of explaining, then blame yourself afterwards.
ham.loi_khuyen: Pick one thing each week for your child to decide entirely, like dinner or where to go out, and keep your word on it.

sang.de_vap: You easily spend for appearances — hosting, gifts, nicer things than you need — especially when others are watching.
sang.loi_khuyen: Every pay day, move 10–20% straight into a separate account before spending, and never use it to keep up appearances.

ham.manh: You're determined to earn money through your own effort, and don't like borrowing or letting others see you short.

ham.loi_khuyen: Set a monthly ceiling for social spending, write it down, and once it's reached, decline politely with a single sentence.

sang.manh: You handle pressure well and keep your composure in front of others, even on days when work piles up.

sang.loi_khuyen: Set a fixed time to stop each evening, switch off your work phone, and hand one task a week to someone else.

ham.manh: You have willpower; when needed you still pull yourself together to get things done, and rarely complain to those around you.

ham.loi_khuyen: Go to bed before 11 pm at least five nights a week, and have a health check-up once a year.

sang.loi_khuyen: Each time you join a new environment, spend the first week listening and asking questions before proposing your own way of doing things.

ham.manh: In unfamiliar places you still keep a dignified manner, and people see you as someone they can trust.
ham.de_vap: Out in the world without anyone to back you, you easily feel overlooked and withdraw, rarely speaking first.
ham.loi_khuyen: Before a trip or a new job, message someone you know there so you have someone to show you around in the first days.

sang.manh: Around you are people with standing who are willing to pass on opportunities when you want to expand your work.
sang.de_vap: Many people come to you, and some of them just want to lean on your reputation without contributing anything.
sang.loi_khuyen: Before agreeing to vouch for or recommend someone, look at what they have actually achieved working with you.

ham.manh: You treat friends and colleagues decently and keep your word, so there are still a few people who genuinely value you.
ham.de_vap: You tend to wait for others to come to you first, so at times there are few people around who can help with something big.
ham.loi_khuyen: Each month, take the initiative to invite a friend you value for coffee, just to catch up, not to talk business.

sang.manh: You suit management roles in places with clear processes; bosses feel at ease handing you difficult tasks.
sang.de_vap: You get annoyed when given petty tasks or treated like a runner, and it easily shows in meetings.
sang.loi_khuyen: When you take on a new task, ask clearly how far your decision-making power goes before you start.

ham.manh: You want to do decent work, take responsibility for your part and dislike doing things half-heartedly.
ham.de_vap: Wanting to be in charge before you're on firm ground, you easily clash with your boss or take on more than you can handle.
ham.loi_khuyen: This year, choose one specific skill for the position you want and study it until you have a result you can show.

sang.manh: You know how to provide a proper, stable home, and where you live is usually the place the whole family feels secure.
sang.de_vap: You easily want a bigger house and nicer things than your income allows, treating the home as a face to show others.
sang.loi_khuyen: Before buying or renovating, make sure the monthly payment is no more than a third of the household's income.

ham.manh: You value a stable roof over your head and are willing to save hard for a place of your own.
ham.de_vap: When you're not yet in a position to buy, you easily get impatient comparing your home with others' and put pressure on yourself.
ham.loi_khuyen: Set up a separate savings pot for a home and put a fixed amount in every month — even if it's small, keep it steady.

sang.manh: You have clear standards inside, and feel at peace doing things of lasting value for your family.
sang.de_vap: You easily feel empty when what you do isn't valued by anyone, even though you're doing it well.
sang.loi_khuyen: At the end of each week, write down one thing you did that helped someone, even if nobody mentioned it.

ham.manh: You have the self-respect to hold to your principles and don't easily do what you believe is wrong.
ham.de_vap: When no one seems to understand you, you easily withdraw and think nobody needs you any more.
ham.loi_khuyen: When you feel low, call someone close and tell them honestly about one thing weighing on you.

sang.manh: You learned good manners and decent conduct from your parents and from respected people who came before you.
sang.de_vap: Out of propriety, you easily hesitate to be frank with your parents or boss, letting small things turn into distance.
sang.loi_khuyen: At a meal with your parents this week, ask them about something from their past and just listen, without commenting.

ham.manh: You care about your family's good name and respect your elders, even when you sometimes disagree with them.
ham.de_vap: When your parents or boss impose their views, you easily dig in, stick to your own view and avoid them instead of talking.
ham.loi_khuyen: When you disagree with an elder, say "I understand what you mean, may I add one thing?" before putting your case.

sang.manh: You're quick-witted; faced with a tangle, you come up with two or three ways out right away, so people often ask your advice when they're stuck.
sang.de_vap: Because your mind runs fast, you easily change plans halfway, leaving the people working with you out of breath.
sang.loi_khuyen: For each important task, write down the direction you've chosen and stick to it for at least two weeks before considering a change.

ham.manh: You notice many details others miss and always have a back-up plan ready.
ham.de_vap: You easily turn a matter over and over, worrying about things that haven't happened yet, and then hesitate to start.
ham.loi_khuyen: When you notice you've been thinking too long, give yourself a 24-hour deadline to choose, then take the first step that same day.

sang.manh: You and your siblings or close friends often talk things through and swap ideas, and usually help each other out with well-timed advice.
sang.de_vap: Talking together works well, but long-term joint projects easily drift apart because each of you has a different plan.
sang.loi_khuyen: When working on something with your siblings, write what you've agreed in a message so you can both look back at it.

ham.manh: You're perceptive about your siblings' moods and often sense when something is wrong before they say so.
ham.de_vap: You easily guess at meanings and read too much in, turning one remark from a sibling into a big deal.
ham.loi_khuyen: Next time a remark upsets you, ask directly "is that what you meant?" before thinking any further.

sang.manh: You suit someone who gets you, someone you can talk with for hours, and the two of you often plan the future together.
sang.de_vap: When you both overthink, you easily read into each other — even a slow reply to a message becomes something to brood over.
sang.loi_khuyen: Agree on one rule with your partner: anything that upsets you gets said the same day, not left overnight to guess about.

ham.manh: You notice every small change in your partner and know how to surprise them with thoughtful touches.
ham.de_vap: When you feel insecure, you easily imagine worst-case scenarios, then probe with questions instead of saying what you're worried about.
ham.loi_khuyen: When you're worried about the relationship, say exactly one sentence — "I'm worried about this" — instead of circling around with questions.

sang.manh: You enjoy teaching your children how to think, answering their "why" questions patiently and with reasons.
sang.de_vap: You easily keep changing your parenting approach with every new article you read, so your child doesn't know what the real rules are.
sang.loi_khuyen: Choose three house rules for your child and keep them unchanged for at least three months, even if you read about a new method.

ham.manh: You care for your children thoroughly, thinking ahead about many things so they're never caught off guard.
ham.de_vap: Worrying too far ahead, you easily ask and remind your child non-stop, making them feel watched rather than cared for.
ham.loi_khuyen: Each day, remind your child of only the single most important thing, and let them handle the rest themselves.

sang.manh: You earn with your head — advising, planning, solving problems — and often find new ways to make money.
sang.de_vap: Your income easily rises and falls from one period to the next, with surplus months and short months if you have no steady earnings.
sang.loi_khuyen: Keep a reserve of three to six months' spending, and only use it in months when income drops.

ham.manh: You take the trouble to research and compare before spending, and rarely buy in a hurry.
ham.de_vap: You easily jump from one way of earning to another before seeing results, so your effort gets spread thin.
ham.loi_khuyen: Pick a single side income and follow it for six months, noting the amount each month, before deciding whether to continue.

sang.manh: Your mind stays alert and handles things quickly, and you know how to adjust your pace when you start to get overloaded.
sang.de_vap: You easily take work to bed, lying there still planning tomorrow, so your sleep is often patchy.
sang.loi_khuyen: An hour before bed, write down everything for tomorrow on paper, then put your phone away from the bed.

ham.manh: You're sensitive to your body and notice right away when something feels different.
ham.de_vap: Worrying a lot, you easily get mentally tired and sleep badly, and tend to read random things online that make you worry more.
ham.loi_khuyen: Keep fixed sleep and wake times, walk 20 minutes a day, and if something feels off, see a doctor instead of searching online.

sang.manh: You adapt quickly to new environments, learn the good things wherever you go and find new ways of doing things.
sang.de_vap: Because you like moving around, you easily leave as soon as you get bored, before you've had time to reap anything where you were.
sang.loi_khuyen: Before deciding to change jobs or move house, write down three things you might lose and three you'd gain, then reread the list a week later.

ham.manh: You're curious and willing to travel and try things, so your knowledge of people and places is fairly wide.
ham.de_vap: Travelling a lot without a clear plan, you can feel you're going in circles, moving from one thing to the next without finding your footing.
ham.loi_khuyen: Each time you plan to move somewhere, set a concrete goal for the new place, like a skill to learn or an amount to save.

sang.manh: You have many bright, varied friends; when you need an idea or advice, you know right away whom to ask.
sang.de_vap: Friends come and go and few stay long, so it's a little hard to find people for long-term projects when you need them.
sang.loi_khuyen: Choose three friends you want to keep for the long run, and message each of them once a month to check in.

ham.manh: You can talk with many kinds of people and know how to choose your words for each situation.
ham.de_vap: You easily doubt other people's good intentions, assuming they have an agenda, so you hesitate to open up to colleagues.
ham.loi_khuyen: When a colleague helps you, thank them by doing something concrete in return instead of guessing what they want.

sang.manh: You're good at planning, analysing and untangling problems; in a team, you suit the role of the one who works out how to do things.
sang.de_vap: You easily get bored with repetitive work, so you often want to change jobs or methods halfway through a project.
sang.loi_khuyen: For each project, set a concrete completion milestone and work through to it before considering any change.

ham.manh: You have lots of ideas for improvement and can see what doesn't make sense in the way your team works.
ham.de_vap: Thinking a lot but rarely settling, you easily give your boss the impression that you talk well but deliver slowly.
ham.loi_khuyen: Each morning, pick the single most important task and finish it before noon, then look at new ideas.

sang.manh: You're very clever about housing: a place that's convenient to get around, neatly laid out and worth the money.
sang.de_vap: You tend to move several times, and each move costs money and the effort of setting everything up again.
sang.loi_khuyen: Before moving house, add up the costs of moving, repairs and deposits, and weigh them against the benefits of at least two years in the new place.

ham.manh: You take the trouble to repair and rearrange your home so it works well, even when the space isn't large.
ham.de_vap: You easily dither over buying or renting and where to live, waiting so long that you miss the good moments.
ham.loi_khuyen: Set three must-have criteria for a home; when a place meets all three, decide within a week.

sang.manh: You're happy when you learn something new or finally understand something, and your curious mind means you rarely get bored with life.
sang.de_vap: Your mind is always running, so it's hard for you to sit still — even on days off you find things to think about.
sang.loi_khuyen: Each day, spend 15 minutes on something that needs no thought, like watering plants, walking or cooking, without opening your phone.

ham.manh: You often reflect on yourself and know how to look back after each event.
ham.de_vap: Too much reflection easily turns into self-torment; you go over a small mistake again and again all week.
ham.loi_khuyen: When you can't stop thinking about a mistake, write it down along with one thing you'll do differently next time, then fold the paper away.

sang.manh: You learned from your parents and bosses how to think ahead, and they often trust you to talk things over with them.
sang.de_vap: You easily guess what your elders want and act on your guess, and when it's off, both sides end up displeased.
sang.loi_khuyen: When your parents or boss ask you to do something, ask one question — "what result would you like?" — before you start.

ham.manh: You care for your parents by planning ahead, preparing for things they might need.
ham.de_vap: You easily do too much worrying on your parents' behalf, then get annoyed when they don't follow the plan you've worked out.
ham.loi_khuyen: Before arranging anything for your parents, ask what they want and let them choose, even if you think another way is better.

sang.manh: You're enthusiastic, straight-talking and work in the open; wherever you go, people remember and trust you easily.
sang.de_vap: You often take on helping others before your own work, and only at the end of the day notice your own tasks are left unfinished.
sang.loi_khuyen: Before agreeing to help someone, check whether your schedule is already full; if it is, offer another day.

ham.manh: You're kind-hearted and care genuinely for others, often without needing anyone to know.
ham.de_vap: You easily give more than you can, looking after everyone with little recognition, then feel tired and hurt when you're on your own.
ham.loi_khuyen: Each week, keep one evening just for your own things, and let people know in advance that you're busy that night.

sang.manh: You're usually the one who looks after your siblings and friends; when something comes up in the family, you're the first person they think of.
sang.de_vap: Used to looking after them, you easily take on your siblings' share too, money included, without anyone noticing.
sang.loi_khuyen: When there's a shared family matter, suggest splitting tasks and costs from the start, writing down who does what.

ham.manh: You have a big heart for your siblings and are ready to help even when you're struggling yourself.
ham.de_vap: You easily help until you're drained, then feel hurt that your siblings take it for granted.
ham.loi_khuyen: Next time a sibling asks for help, say clearly how far you can help, and leave the rest for them to handle.

sang.manh: You choose someone decent and honourable, and the two of you can stand side by side proudly in front of everyone.
sang.de_vap: You easily get busy with work and friends outside, and by the time you're home your partner feels they come after everything else.
sang.loi_khuyen: Keep one evening a week just for the two of you, and don't accept anyone else's invitation for that night.

ham.manh: You look after your partner through concrete actions — you say little but do a lot.
ham.de_vap: You easily take care of the whole household, then quietly resent that your partner doesn't notice, yet you don't say anything.
ham.loi_khuyen: Tell your partner one specific thing you'd like help with this week, like washing up or picking up the kids one day.

sang.manh: You want to be an example to your children and live openly, and they're usually open and willing to say what they think.
sang.de_vap: Being busy outside a lot, you easily make it up to your children with gifts rather than with time spent together.
sang.loi_khuyen: Each day, spend 15 minutes with your child without your phone, letting them tell you anything they want.

ham.manh: You sacrifice a lot for your children, taking care of everything from meals to schoolwork and rarely taking credit.
ham.de_vap: Doing too much for your children, you easily run yourself into the ground and snap at them over small things.
ham.loi_khuyen: Give your child one age-appropriate household chore each day — it helps them grow and takes part of the load off you.

sang.manh: Money comes to you through visible work, your reputation and the trust of many people.
sang.de_vap: You're generous, quick to treat friends and lend money, so by the end of the month there's sometimes not much left.
sang.loi_khuyen: Every pay day, move 15% straight into savings before thinking about treating anyone or lending.

ham.manh: You work hard, and because your money is earned with sweat, you understand its value.
ham.de_vap: You easily spend on others first, and then come up short when you need it yourself.
ham.loi_khuyen: Before lending anyone money, ask yourself whether you'd be fine if you never got it back; if not, say no.

sang.manh: You have stamina, stay cheerful even with a lot of work, and recover quickly if you actually rest.
sang.de_vap: You easily overwork because you can't bring yourself to say no; the old books link this area with the eyes and heart rhythm, so look after them preventively.
sang.loi_khuyen: Have a check-up every year, rest your eyes for 5 minutes after every hour of screen time, and sleep a full seven hours each night.

ham.manh: You're hard-working, rarely complain of tiredness, and can still step up when the family needs you.
ham.de_vap: Used to looking after others, you easily forget to eat on time, stay up late and let your strength slip without noticing.
ham.loi_khuyen: Set alarms for lunch and bedtime, and treat them as appointments with yourself you can't miss.

sang.manh: Out in the world many people know you; you suit broad settings with networking and public speaking.
sang.de_vap: You easily accept too many meetings and events, then keep running around with no energy left for your main work.
sang.loi_khuyen: Each week, choose at most two outside engagements, and move other invitations to the following week.

ham.manh: You're kind to strangers and happy to help in new places, so there are still people who remember your kindness.
ham.de_vap: In a new place you can easily do a lot without being seen, and others often take credit for your work.
ham.loi_khuyen: After finishing something for the team, send a short summary to the person in charge so your effort is on record.

sang.manh: You have a wide network and often help people, so when you need it, many are willing to help you back.
sang.de_vap: Your kindness can easily be overused; some people only look for you when they need a favour.
sang.loi_khuyen: Notice who only gets in touch when they need something; next time, help them with just a small part and see how they respond.

ham.manh: You treat colleagues and team members well and often stand up for people in a weaker position.
ham.de_vap: You easily take on others' work and get seen as the person who can do everything, so more and more work lands on you.
ham.loi_khuyen: When a colleague pushes work your way, say "I'm on this now; I can do it once it's done", with a specific date.

sang.manh: You suit visible work that helps many people, like teaching, media, community service or team management.
sang.de_vap: You easily keep taking on more roles because you want recognition, and when you're overloaded everything gets rushed.
sang.loi_khuyen: Before taking on more responsibility, drop or hand back one old task to keep things balanced.

ham.manh: You're good at specialist work, working quietly but with a steady hand, suited to a behind-the-scenes support role.
ham.de_vap: You easily feel you do a lot but rarely get promoted, then push for recognition and tire yourself out more.
ham.loi_khuyen: Choose one area of expertise and go deep enough that people have to come to you, instead of trying to be part of everything.

sang.manh: Your home is usually bright and open to guests, and the property you have comes from your own hard work.
sang.de_vap: With so many guests, you easily spend a lot on hosting and have little quiet space of your own.
sang.loi_khuyen: Keep a small corner of the house just for you, and sit there for ten undisturbed minutes each evening.

ham.manh: You work hard to build up the home and make sure the people in it have a decent place to live.
ham.de_vap: You easily take on housing for the whole extended family, carrying more of the repairs or instalments than you can manage.
ham.loi_khuyen: When pooling money for a shared home with relatives, write down each person's share and keep a copy of the papers.

sang.manh: You're happy when you can be useful, and your generous heart means you rarely hold on to old grievances.
sang.de_vap: You easily measure your worth by being needed, so days when no one asks you for anything feel empty.
sang.loi_khuyen: Each week, do one thing simply because you enjoy it, not because anyone needs it, like reading, sport or learning a new dish.

ham.manh: You live with feeling, remember those who helped you and try to repay them.
ham.de_vap: Giving a lot and getting little back, you easily feel drained inside, tired without knowing whom to tell.
ham.loi_khuyen: When you feel emotionally worn out, tell a trusted friend honestly "I'm running on empty lately", and let them look after you for once.

sang.manh: You learned a sense of responsibility and an upright way of working from your father and the people who came before you.
sang.de_vap: You easily carry pressure to make your parents proud, taking on big things just to be praised.
sang.loi_khuyen: Tell your parents about one thing you're doing because you enjoy it, not because they expect it, and explain why.

ham.manh: You take responsibility for your parents and are usually the one who does the most in the family.
ham.de_vap: You easily take on all the care of your parents without telling your siblings, then get tired without anyone knowing.
ham.loi_khuyen: Set up a group chat with your siblings to share the schedule for visiting and caring for your parents, each taking a part.

sang.manh: You decide fast, follow through and are good with money matters; people who give you a task can rest assured it will get done.
sang.de_vap: You can be so direct that it comes across as hard, especially when the other person is upset and just needs to be heard.
sang.loi_khuyen: When someone close tells you something sad, ask "do you want me to just listen, or do you want my advice?" before you speak.

ham.manh: You're fair and square, do what you say, and don't like owing anyone.
ham.de_vap: You easily clash because you speak bluntly and hold your ground, then find yourself standing alone when things don't go smoothly.
ham.loi_khuyen: In your next argument, say one sentence acknowledging the other person's view before giving your own.

sang.manh: You and your siblings are fair and clear with each other; when you help, the help is real, and money matters are transparent.
sang.de_vap: The relationship easily cools if money gets involved, like loans or dividing property without saying things clearly.
sang.loi_khuyen: For every loan to a sibling or joint contribution, put the amount and repayment date in a message that you both keep.

ham.manh: You're straightforward with your siblings, say what you think and don't hold grudges for long.
ham.de_vap: You tend to talk with your siblings only about money and practical matters, and over time you drift apart without knowing why.
ham.loi_khuyen: Next time you call a sibling, ask about something that has nothing to do with money or family chores.

sang.manh: You suit a practical, capable partner; when the two of you share the household finances, the home is solid.
sang.de_vap: Talking about money too much can dry out the affection, turning dinner into a budget meeting.
sang.loi_khuyen: Set aside one session a week for money talk, and leave money out of all other meals.

ham.manh: You look after your family through practical action; you promise little but keep your word.
ham.de_vap: You tend to say few tender words, so your partner may feel you manage more than you care.
ham.loi_khuyen: Each day, send your partner one short message that isn't about chores, like "how are you doing today?".

sang.manh: You raise your children with discipline and a respect for money, and they usually grow up independent and thorough.
sang.de_vap: You can be too strict, praising little and criticising a lot, so your child hesitates to come to you with problems.
sang.loi_khuyen: Each day, praise your child for one specific thing they did well, naming exactly what it was.

ham.manh: You provide fully for your children, planning ahead for their schooling and finances.
ham.de_vap: You tend to show love through money and expectations, rather than words and hugs.
ham.loi_khuyen: Tonight, ask your child "anything fun happen today?" and listen all the way through without slipping in lessons.

sang.manh: You're good at earning and keeping money, spend to a plan, and know where money should sit to grow.
sang.de_vap: You easily begrudge spending on things that can't be measured, like rest or gifts for loved ones.
sang.loi_khuyen: Each month, set aside a small amount purely for your own and your family's enjoyment, and spend it all without regret.

ham.manh: You're decisive when an opportunity arises and willing to put in the effort to make money.
ham.de_vap: Money comes and goes easily: in good months you spend freely, and the next month you're short without knowing where it went.
ham.loi_khuyen: Log every expense on your phone for one month, and at the end cut back the category that took the most.

sang.manh: You're disciplined with your body; once you set an exercise routine or bedtime, you usually stick to it.
sang.de_vap: You tend to bottle stress up inside and tell no one, and by the time you feel tired it has been going on a while.
sang.loi_khuyen: Each week, choose one way to release pressure through movement, like running or swimming, and put it in your calendar like a meeting.

ham.manh: You endure well; in hard times you grit your teeth and get things done.
ham.de_vap: Used to enduring, you easily ignore your body's signs of tiredness, telling yourself it's nothing yet.
ham.loi_khuyen: Book a regular check-up today, and if tiredness lasts more than a week, go and get checked instead of waiting.

sang.manh: Out in the business world you're steady, suited to competitive settings where results speak in numbers.
sang.de_vap: Out there you tend to see only the task and pay little attention to people, so relationships stay at the level of business partners.
sang.loi_khuyen: After each business meeting, remember one personal thing about the other person and ask about it next time.

ham.manh: You dare to travel far for work and can put up with hardship in unfamiliar settings.
ham.de_vap: In unfamiliar places you easily clash because you speak bluntly, and come across as hard to approach.
ham.loi_khuyen: In your first week somewhere new, greet people and ask their views before commenting on how they work.

sang.manh: You work with colleagues clearly and fairly; whoever does well gets proper credit.
sang.de_vap: You tend to look only at results and pay little attention to how your co-workers feel, so it's hard to keep people for long.
sang.loi_khuyen: Each week, privately thank one colleague with specific words about what they did.

ham.manh: You're fair with your friends and don't take advantage of anyone.
ham.de_vap: You easily get caught up in money matters with friends — lending or co-investing and then falling out.
ham.loi_khuyen: Don't co-invest with a friend until you have a paper stating each person's contribution, share and how to pull out.

sang.manh: You suit work that needs decisiveness and numbers, such as finance, engineering, management or disciplined business.
sang.de_vap: You tend to expect others to match your pace, making the whole team tense before deadlines.
sang.loi_khuyen: When assigning work, ask the person how long they need and agree on the deadline with them rather than setting it alone.

ham.manh: You're hard-working, willing to do heavy work, and talented at things that need real skill.
ham.de_vap: You can be rigid with your boss or clients, sticking to your way of doing things even when circumstances have changed.
ham.loi_khuyen: When someone criticises how you work, try their way once and compare the results.

sang.manh: You build up property to a plan, think about long-term value in every purchase, and your savings grow steadily.
sang.de_vap: You tend to treat the home as an asset more than a nest — tidy, but lacking a place for the family to gather.
sang.loi_khuyen: Set aside a corner of the house for family photos and keepsakes, a place where everyone tends to sit together.

ham.manh: You work hard to own property and take careful care of your belongings.
ham.de_vap: You easily decide on property deals quickly on impulse, then get squeezed by instalments.
ham.loi_khuyen: Before putting money into property, wait at least three days and ask someone who knows the field.

sang.manh: You feel at peace when everything is under control: money planned, work scheduled, the home in order.
sang.de_vap: You easily get uncomfortable when something unplanned happens, and even on days off you go back over the accounts.
sang.loi_khuyen: Each week, keep one unplanned session to do whatever you feel like, and practise accepting a few things going off schedule.

ham.manh: You rarely complain and can handle your own affairs.
ham.de_vap: You tend to keep everything inside; few people know what you're thinking, so you feel lonely without saying so.
ham.loi_khuyen: Choose one person you trust and, once a month, tell them about something that's on your mind.

sang.manh: You learned discipline and follow-through from your parents and strict bosses, and that gave you solid skills.
sang.de_vap: You easily find your parents or boss demanding and keep your distance, talking only when there's something to sort out.
sang.loi_khuyen: This week, call your parents just to check in, with nothing to ask for or report.

ham.manh: You respect your parents' principles; even when you disagree, you still do your part.
ham.de_vap: You and your parents easily speak harshly to each other — both blunt, so you often clash.
ham.loi_khuyen: When you disagree with your parents, lower your voice, speak slowly, and stop before it turns into shouting.

sang.manh: You're approachable and good-humoured, you make any place easier to breathe in, and when trouble comes someone usually helps.
sang.de_vap: You dislike conflict, so you tend to put hard tasks off until tomorrow and only tackle them when they become urgent.
sang.loi_khuyen: Each morning, do the hardest task first, just for 30 minutes, before moving on to the easier ones.

ham.manh: You're gentle and adaptable; even when circumstances change, you still find small joys.
ham.de_vap: You easily drift with circumstances, letting other people or luck decide for you.
ham.loi_khuyen: Write down one goal for the next three months, stick it where you'll see it, and take one small step each week.

sang.manh: You get on well with your siblings and friends; you enjoy each other's company and rarely stay angry for long.
sang.de_vap: Not wanting to spoil the peace, you tend to stay quiet when a sibling treats you unfairly.
sang.loi_khuyen: Next time something bothers you, say one gentle sentence right then instead of laughing it off.

ham.manh: You often give way to your siblings and rarely fight for your share.
ham.de_vap: You easily lean on your siblings, leaving the hard family tasks to them.
ham.loi_khuyen: Take on one shared family task this month and see it through without waiting to be reminded.

sang.manh: You suit a calm, gentle love, know how to make your partner feel cared for, and your presence makes home feel light.
sang.de_vap: You tend to dodge problems between you, laughing them off and letting them simmer.
sang.loi_khuyen: When something comes up between you, agree to talk within a day, each speaking for five minutes without interrupting.

ham.manh: You're sweet and quick to make up after a quarrel.
ham.de_vap: You tend to want to be pampered while taking little initiative with housework, so your partner feels they carry more.
ham.loi_khuyen: Take on one fixed household task, like grocery shopping or laundry, and do it regularly without being reminded.

sang.manh: You're close to your children, can play with them, and they feel comfortable telling you things.
sang.de_vap: You tend to indulge your children, saying "no" and then changing your mind when they plead.
sang.loi_khuyen: Choose two "no" rules at home and hold to them every time, even if your child cries or begs.

ham.manh: You're gentle with your children and rarely shout, so they aren't afraid of you.
ham.de_vap: You tend to leave raising your children to others, then get caught by surprise when something comes up.
ham.loi_khuyen: Each week, spend one session looking at your child's schoolwork or asking about school, and note what they tell you.

sang.manh: Your money comes in steadily, rarely with big shortfalls, and you know how to spend on pleasures that are worth it.
sang.de_vap: You easily spend on small daily pleasures — coffee, eating out, cute things — which add up to a large sum.
sang.loi_khuyen: Set a weekly pocket-money limit, move it into a separate wallet in advance, and stop when it's gone.

ham.manh: You don't put too much weight on money, so you rarely fall out with anyone over it.
ham.de_vap: You tend to avoid doing the sums, letting money slip away until you get a shock at the end of the month.
ham.loi_khuyen: Set up an automatic transfer of a fixed amount into savings on pay day.

sang.manh: You have a relaxed outlook and little stress, so you recover your energy fairly quickly after tiring days.
sang.de_vap: You tend to eat on a whim, sit a lot and avoid exercise, so your body slowly gets sluggish without you noticing.
sang.loi_khuyen: Walk for 30 minutes every day after dinner, and eat three meals at roughly the same times.

ham.manh: You know how to rest and don't push yourself too hard.
ham.de_vap: You tend to put off looking after yourself, like booking a check-up or starting exercise, and never get round to it.
ham.loi_khuyen: Book a regular check-up this week, and invite a friend to exercise with you so someone reminds you.

sang.manh: Out in the world people warm to you easily and help you wherever you go; you suit trips for new experiences.
sang.de_vap: You easily get carried away with fun when out, agreeing to go out and forgetting what you'd already planned.
sang.loi_khuyen: Before agreeing to an outing, open your schedule for that day and check it first.

ham.manh: You blend easily into new places and don't offend anyone.
ham.de_vap: In a new environment you tend to wait for others to lead, rarely seeking out opportunities yourself.
ham.loi_khuyen: In a new place, introduce yourself to one person each week and ask what they're working on.

sang.manh: You have many cheerful friends and easy-going colleagues; everyone wants to work alongside you.
sang.de_vap: You have many friends but few to take on big projects with, so when you need to join forces you lack hard workers.
sang.loi_khuyen: When you need to do something big, choose people for what they've actually achieved, not just because they're fun to be with.

ham.manh: You forgive friends easily and don't hold grudges.
ham.de_vap: You easily get talked into outings by friends that eat up time and money.
ham.loi_khuyen: Limit evenings out to two a week, and on other evenings say honestly that you're busy with your own things.

sang.manh: You suit service, care or education work in a stable environment, where your easy-going nature is valued.
sang.de_vap: You tend to shy away from hard tasks or high-pressure roles, so you pass up chances for promotion.
sang.loi_khuyen: This year, take on at least one task slightly beyond your ability, and ask an experienced person to guide you.

ham.manh: You work peacefully, cause little conflict and keep the team atmosphere good.
ham.de_vap: You tend to do just enough without setting your own goals, so year after year your work doesn't seem to move forward.
ham.loi_khuyen: At the start of each month, write down one concrete result you want at work, and at the end check whether you did it.

sang.manh: You know how to make a home comfortable and convenient, and your place is where people like to drop by.
sang.de_vap: You tend to buy things for the home on a whim, so it fills up with stuff and runs short of space.
sang.loi_khuyen: Every time you buy something new for the home, throw out or give away one old thing.

ham.manh: You don't place much weight on big assets and can live happily anywhere.
ham.de_vap: You tend to be slow to plan long-term housing, renting on and on without a plan.
ham.loi_khuyen: Work out the year by which you'd like a stable home, then divide that into the amount you need to save each month.

sang.manh: You're optimistic, find joy in small things, and that's exactly what gets you through hard times.
sang.de_vap: You tend to use fun as a way to avoid thinking about things that need sorting out.
sang.loi_khuyen: Each week, write down one thing you're avoiding and take its smallest step that same day.

ham.manh: You're gentle, rarely envious, and live without harming anyone.
ham.de_vap: You tend to give up when things get hard, thinking "never mind" and letting everything drift.
ham.loi_khuyen: When you want to give up, promise yourself to try exactly one more time before deciding to stop.

sang.manh: Your parents and elders love and protect you, and relationships at home are usually warm.
sang.de_vap: Used to being looked after, you can be slow to become independent, still waiting for your parents to decide big things.
sang.loi_khuyen: Make one big decision about your own life this year, then tell your parents instead of asking permission first.

ham.manh: You're dutiful, rarely argue with your parents and keep the peace at home.
ham.de_vap: You tend to go along with your parents or boss even on things you don't want, then do them unhappily.
ham.loi_khuyen: Next time you disagree with an elder, say gently "I'd like to try it this way" and give one reason.

sang.manh: You have clear principles, work precisely and have a pull that makes others want to follow you.
sang.de_vap: You easily react strongly when something goes against you, and your words come out harsher than you really mean.
sang.loi_khuyen: When you feel yourself heating up, count to ten or step out for a glass of water before replying.

ham.manh: You have strong feelings and determination; once you want something, you follow it to the end.
ham.de_vap: You're quick to anger and take offence, and sometimes get drawn into gossip that isn't yours.
ham.loi_khuyen: When something annoys you, wait a night before messaging or talking to the other person.

sang.manh: You and your siblings all have your own views, and when you pull in the same direction you achieve big things.
sang.de_vap: Everyone holds to their own view, so small family matters easily get tense, especially splitting tasks and shares.
sang.loi_khuyen: When discussing family matters, let each person state their view in turn, write them down, then choose together.

ham.manh: You defend your siblings wholeheartedly when outsiders give them a hard time.
ham.de_vap: You easily get angry with a sibling over one remark and keep up the attitude for a long time.
ham.loi_khuyen: After each tense moment with a sibling, send a friendly message within three days.

sang.manh: You love wholeheartedly and faithfully, and hope your partner will be just as committed.
sang.de_vap: Because you love so strongly, you can get jealous and demanding; one unfamiliar message can unsettle you all day.
sang.loi_khuyen: Tell your partner what makes you feel insecure, then agree on a few things you're both comfortable with.

ham.manh: You're passionate and ardent, and have a strong pull on the person you like.
ham.de_vap: When you argue with your partner, you easily say hurtful things or bring up the past, leaving scratches that are slow to heal.
ham.loi_khuyen: Agree with your partner on a pause phrase, like "let's take 30 minutes", to use whenever an argument gets big.

sang.manh: You teach your children to live honestly and keep their word, and they learn from you how to hold to principles.
sang.de_vap: You can set the bar too high, so one mistake from your child gets brought up again and again.
sang.loi_khuyen: When your child makes a mistake, say it once clearly, then don't bring it up again that week.

ham.manh: You love your children fiercely and will do anything to protect them.
ham.de_vap: When you're tired and your child won't listen, you easily raise your voice and regret it afterwards.
ham.loi_khuyen: When you feel about to shout at your child, go into another room for two minutes, then come back and talk.

sang.manh: You earn through organisation and discipline; your money comes from clear, honest work.
sang.de_vap: When you see a big opportunity, you can get swept into quick-money schemes that aren't transparent.
sang.loi_khuyen: For any investment promising high returns, ask exactly where the profit comes from; if there's no clear answer, don't put money in.

ham.manh: You're determined to build wealth and dare to think big about money.
ham.de_vap: You easily spend on emotion, when happy or annoyed, or believe pitches for quick business deals.
ham.loi_khuyen: Set yourself a rule: any expense above an amount you choose must wait 48 hours before you decide.

sang.manh: You have stamina and discipline; once you decide on a routine, you keep it.
sang.de_vap: Stress that builds up for a long time can burst out as anger, wearing out both your body and your mind.
sang.loi_khuyen: Do three sweaty workouts a week, like running, swimming or cycling, to release pressure.

ham.manh: You know what your body needs when you're willing to listen to it.
ham.de_vap: When annoyed, you tend to take it out through eating, staying up late or overworking to forget.
ham.loi_khuyen: When you're annoyed, swap snacking or scrolling for ten minutes of walking outside.

sang.manh: Out in the world you have presence, easily get noticed, and suit roles where you step up to handle difficult matters.
sang.de_vap: Being noticed a lot also means being talked about, especially when you speak bluntly in front of a crowd.
sang.loi_khuyen: In public, give feedback to the person privately rather than in front of everyone.

ham.manh: You dare to go to new places and face difficult situations.
ham.de_vap: Out in the world you can easily get caught up in gossip or clashes because of a moment's temper.
ham.loi_khuyen: When someone provokes you out and about, choose to walk away first; right and wrong can be settled later.

sang.manh: You have a pull on colleagues and know how to organise people to work by principle.
sang.de_vap: Relationships around you easily get complicated, mixing personal feelings with work.
sang.loi_khuyen: Keep clear boundaries: money and work matters with friends always get a message or paper on record.

ham.manh: You're loyal to those you trust and ready to help friends in hard times.
ham.de_vap: You easily get pulled into other people's conflicts, take a side and end up with a bad name.
ham.loi_khuyen: When friends badmouth someone, just listen — don't pass it on and don't play judge.

sang.manh: You suit work needing discipline and precision, such as management, legal compliance, engineering or quality control.
sang.de_vap: You can be harsh on colleagues; when someone breaks procedure, your annoyance shows openly.
sang.loi_khuyen: When you see a colleague doing something wrong, tell them privately and offer the fix along with the mistake.

ham.manh: You're ambitious and willing to work hard to reach the position you want.
ham.de_vap: Wanting to go fast, you may consider shortcuts, or clash with your boss when you see unfairness.
ham.loi_khuyen: For every chance to get ahead fast, ask yourself whether you'd be fine if it became public; if not, drop it.

sang.manh: You look after your home and property carefully, with clear paperwork, so your assets last.
sang.de_vap: You can get tense with housemates over small household rules.
sang.loi_khuyen: Hold a short family meeting to agree on five shared house rules, and leave everyone free beyond those five.

ham.manh: You're determined to secure a home through your own effort.
ham.de_vap: You can run into trouble when co-owning property or buying and selling without proper paperwork.
ham.loi_khuyen: For every property deal, read the contract carefully and have a professional check it before you sign.

sang.manh: You live by the values you believe in, and feel at peace when what you do is clear and honest.
sang.de_vap: Inside, you often wrestle between what you want and what you think is right.
sang.loi_khuyen: When you're torn, write two columns, "want" and "should", then choose the option you won't regret a year from now.

ham.manh: You have strong passions and live wholeheartedly for what you love.
ham.de_vap: You tend to blame yourself after losing your temper, dwelling on what you said.
ham.loi_khuyen: After a slip of the tongue, give the other person a short apology, then allow yourself to let it go.

sang.manh: You learned principle and seriousness at work from your parents and bosses.
sang.de_vap: You and your elders easily get tense when both hold to their own principles and neither will back down.
sang.loi_khuyen: When you disagree with your parents or boss, find one point you both agree on first, then continue.

ham.manh: You dare to tell your elders truths that others hesitate to say.
ham.de_vap: You tend to react sharply when superiors impose on you, making the relationship harder.
ham.loi_khuyen: When you disagree with your boss, ask for a private meeting and prepare three reasons backed by figures.

sang.manh: You're calm, trustworthy and careful with what you have, so people feel safe trusting you with tasks or money.
