sang.de_vap: You tend to stay in the safe zone too long, passing up opportunities because you dislike change.
sang.loi_khuyen: Each quarter, try one small new thing at work or in life, at a level of risk you can accept.

ham.manh: You're careful and rarely reckless, so you seldom have big mistakes to fix.
ham.de_vap: Without support, you easily worry about not having enough, become overly cautious and hold tight to everything.
ham.loi_khuyen: Next time a new opportunity comes up, ask a friend you trust, then decide within a week instead of letting it drag on.

sang.manh: Your siblings and friends are a practical support; whatever you need, you can ask them.
sang.de_vap: The bond is lasting but tends to stop at looking after each other materially, with few heart-to-heart talks.
sang.loi_khuyen: Next time you see your siblings, ask about something they're worried about, not money or family chores.

ham.manh: You look after your siblings thoughtfully when they need it, even if you don't say much.
ham.de_vap: You tend to keep your siblings at arm's length, reluctant to ask for help in case you're a bother.
ham.loi_khuyen: This month, ask a sibling for a small favour, so they get the chance to help you back.

sang.manh: You suit a thoughtful partner and together build a stable, well-ordered family.
sang.de_vap: Long stability can turn routine, with the two of you living side by side but little new to talk about.
sang.loi_khuyen: Each month, do one thing together you've never done, like a new dish or a new place to visit.

ham.manh: You're faithful and protective of your family, rarely changing your heart.
ham.de_vap: You tend to hold tight to old habits, so whatever your partner wants to change feels hard.
ham.loi_khuyen: When your partner suggests changing something at home, agree to try it for a month before judging.

sang.manh: You look after your children thoroughly and amply, and they grow up within a solid structure.
sang.de_vap: You tend to provide a lot materially for your children but spend little time talking with them.
sang.loi_khuyen: Each evening, ask your child one question about their day and hear the whole answer before asking about schoolwork.

ham.manh: You're careful with your children, planning each step ahead for them.
ham.de_vap: You tend to over-protect your child, rarely letting them try things and face the consequences themselves.
ham.loi_khuyen: Let your child do one thing you still do for them, like packing their school bag or buying something from a nearby shop.

sang.manh: You're good at saving and careful with spending, managing money like a storehouse and rarely running short.
sang.de_vap: You tend to hold money too tightly, leaving it idle instead of letting it work.
sang.loi_khuyen: Split your savings in two: an emergency part you leave untouched, and a part you research carefully and invest for the long term.

ham.manh: You know how to economise, don't squander money, and can manage even in hard times.
ham.de_vap: You easily worry about money even when you have enough, begrudging even necessary spending on yourself.
ham.loi_khuyen: List your essential monthly expenses for yourself, like food and regular check-ups, then spend on them without hesitation.

sang.manh: You live moderately, keep regular eating and sleeping habits, and your body is usually steady.
sang.de_vap: You tend to build up stress from trying to keep everything safe, and eat irregularly when something worries you.
sang.loi_khuyen: Eat three meals on time, eat slowly, and walk for at least 20 minutes after dinner.

ham.manh: Once you know how, you're diligent about looking after your health.
ham.de_vap: You tend to worry quietly, eating a lot or skipping meals when something is unsettled.
ham.loi_khuyen: When you notice yourself worrying, write the worry down with one thing you can do right now, then go and do it.

sang.manh: Out in the world you're trusted, suited to roles that keep tasks, money and people together in a group.
sang.de_vap: Out there you tend to shy away from new environments and want to stay where it's familiar.
sang.loi_khuyen: Each year, accept at least one work trip or course somewhere you've never been.

ham.manh: You're cautious when out and about and rarely get caught up in pointless trouble.
ham.de_vap: You tend to hold back in unfamiliar places and rarely speak up, so few people learn what you can do.
ham.loi_khuyen: In a new place, volunteer for a small task you're good at so people can see what you can do.

sang.manh: You have trustworthy friends — few but lasting, and there when you need them.
sang.de_vap: You tend to stick to your familiar circle and rarely branch out, so when you need a new opportunity there's no one to introduce you.
sang.loi_khuyen: Each month, accept one get-together with people outside your usual circle.

ham.manh: You treat your friends decently and keep your word.
ham.de_vap: You're slow to trust new people and keep your distance for a long time, so it's hard to make new friends.
ham.loi_khuyen: Next time someone new invites you for coffee, accept once and ask them one question about their work.

sang.manh: You suit administration, finance or asset management, where a steady, careful person is needed.
sang.de_vap: You tend to shy away from new, risky tasks, so you progress more slowly than others even though you're capable.
sang.loi_khuyen: When your boss offers a new task, accept first and then list the support you need, instead of refusing because you're unsure.

ham.manh: You work carefully with few errors, suited to jobs that need procedures followed.
ham.de_vap: You tend to stick to the old way even when a better one exists, so the team sees you as set in your ways.
ham.loi_khuyen: Each quarter, learn one new tool or method in your field and try it on a small task.

sang.manh: You value home and land, and build up property gradually with a steady hand.
sang.de_vap: You tend to pour all your money into property, then struggle when you need cash.
sang.loi_khuyen: Before buying more property, keep enough cash to cover at least six months of spending.

ham.manh: You know how to look after your home, and your belongings last a long time.
ham.de_vap: You tend to keep too many old things because you can't bear to part with them, so the house gets cramped.
ham.loi_khuyen: Each month, clear one drawer or shelf, and give away anything you haven't used in a year.

sang.manh: You feel secure when you have a solid foundation, and your generous heart means you rarely lose sleep over others.
sang.de_vap: You tend to need everything to be plentiful before you feel at ease, so you worry even about things you aren't short of.
sang.loi_khuyen: Each evening, write down three things you have enough of, to practise feeling settled already.

ham.manh: You know when enough is enough and don't chase things beyond your reach.
ham.de_vap: You tend to worry far ahead, afraid of losing what you have, so you avoid change even when it would be better.
ham.loi_khuyen: When you fear a change, ask yourself "what's the worst that could happen, and could I handle it?", then write the answer down.

sang.manh: Your parents and superiors are attentive and protective, and you inherited their carefulness.
sang.de_vap: Being protected a lot, you tend to hesitate to step up and decide big matters yourself.
sang.loi_khuyen: This year, take full charge of one big family matter yourself, like a home repair or organising a memorial gathering.

ham.manh: You look after your parents attentively and remember the small things they need.
ham.de_vap: You tend to hold back with your parents, not telling them anything for fear of worrying them.
ham.loi_khuyen: Tell your parents about one real worry you have, so they can give advice instead of only hearing good news.

sang.manh: You're perceptive — one look at someone's face tells you whether they're tired or happy — so people around you feel comfortable and noticed.
sang.de_vap: You tend to keep sadness inside while laughing and chatting on the surface, then burst out when overloaded, catching others by surprise.
sang.loi_khuyen: Each evening, spend five minutes writing down one thing that stung that day, then pick someone you trust to talk to when you need it.

ham.manh: You're more sensitive than most, so you easily empathise with people having a hard time and know the right words of comfort.
ham.de_vap: Your mood rises and falls with small things; even a curt reply to a message is enough to keep you thinking all afternoon.
ham.loi_khuyen: When you notice yourself guessing what others mean, ask one short direct question instead of reading into it late into the night.

sang.manh: With siblings and close friends, you're the one who remembers birthdays, checks in when they're ill and quietly looks after them without needing credit.
sang.de_vap: You easily feel hurt when you look after everyone and no one asks after you, then drift away in silence instead of saying so.
sang.loi_khuyen: Next time you feel hurt, send your sibling an honest line: lately I could use a bit of checking in too.

ham.manh: You understand your siblings' feelings even when they don't speak, so you're often the first to notice something is wrong at home.
ham.de_vap: You easily take a casual remark at dinner to heart and stay quietly upset for days without the other person knowing.
ham.loi_khuyen: When a remark upsets you, bring it up within a day in a gentle voice: what you said earlier hurt me a bit.

sang.manh: In love you're thoughtful, remember what your partner likes and know when to simply sit beside them in silence.
sang.de_vap: You hope your partner will just understand you, so you easily feel let down when they can't guess what you haven't said.
sang.loi_khuyen: Instead of waiting for your partner to notice, state one specific wish clearly, for example: tonight I'd like us to go for a walk together.

ham.manh: You notice every small change in your partner, so you easily spot when they're tired or having trouble at work.
ham.de_vap: When you argue, you tend to withdraw, thinking more than speaking, so the other person doesn't know what's upsetting you.
ham.loi_khuyen: When you're angry, agree to continue in an hour, and meanwhile write down what you really want your partner to understand.

sang.manh: You care for your children meticulously, remember all their eating and sleeping habits, and they often see you as a soft place to land and talk.
sang.de_vap: You easily worry too much; one late homecoming makes you imagine all sorts of things and scold your child before hearing them out.
sang.loi_khuyen: Each week, spend one session just listening to your child, with no advice and no lessons — only asking: and then what?

ham.manh: You really understand sensitive children and know when your child needs a hug more than an explanation.
ham.de_vap: Your feelings easily spread to your child: on days you're sad, the whole house goes quiet and your child doesn't understand why.
ham.loi_khuyen: On days you're tired, tell your child plainly: I'm a bit tired today, and it's not because of you — then rest a little early.

sang.manh: You're good at keeping money; on pay day you set some aside, and saving little by little turns into a sizeable sum after a few years.
sang.de_vap: You tend to avoid talking about money, lend to acquaintances without writing it down, then feel hurt when they forget to repay.
sang.loi_khuyen: Set up automatic savings on pay day, and record every loan you make along with the agreed repayment date.

ham.manh: You're good at stretching the family budget and know where things are cheap and what's worth the money.
ham.de_vap: When you're sad you tend to shop for comfort, or go along with an acquaintance's investment pitch without asking enough questions.
ham.loi_khuyen: Set a rule: anything above a fixed amount waits three days before you buy it, and every investment must be on paper.

sang.manh: You listen to your body; when you're tired, you find a way to rest, whether going to bed early or making a warm cup of tea.
sang.de_vap: Your mood directly affects your sleep and meals; when something upsets you, you toss and turn and skip meals.
sang.loi_khuyen: Keep a fixed bedtime, leave your phone outside the bedroom after 10 pm, and eat full meals even on busy days.

ham.manh: You notice early when you're starting to get tense, and if you just pause a little you recover fairly quickly.
ham.de_vap: You tend to grit your teeth and finish things even when tired, then lie awake because your mind won't stop.
ham.loi_khuyen: When your thoughts wander as you lie in bed, get up and write them all down before going back; have a check-up every year.

sang.manh: Out in the world you're reserved at first, but people come to value you because you're thoughtful, remember names and ask after people at the right time.
sang.de_vap: In unfamiliar places you easily hesitate to speak up, letting someone else voice your good idea first and then regretting it.
sang.loi_khuyen: In a meeting or a new gathering, aim to share at least one of your ideas in the first fifteen minutes.

ham.manh: You observe carefully before stepping into a new place, so you rarely say the wrong thing or upset anyone.
ham.de_vap: When you travel or change environments, you easily feel lost and homesick, retreating to a corner instead of making acquaintances.
ham.loi_khuyen: Each time you arrive somewhere new, start a conversation with one person first, even if it's just asking where to get lunch nearby.

sang.manh: You have few friends, but each one is close, and many people come to you to confide when they're in a muddle.
sang.de_vap: You listen to others' troubles so much that you get exhausted, yet rarely share your own.
sang.loi_khuyen: When a friend calls to confide while you're already tired, say honestly: I'll call you tomorrow so I can hear you out properly.

ham.manh: You have fairly good instincts about people; after a few meetings you can tell who is sincere and who isn't.
ham.de_vap: You easily trust smooth talkers, then get hurt when they only come to you when they need something.
ham.loi_khuyen: Before agreeing to a big favour, ask yourself: last time I needed help, was this person there?

sang.manh: At work you're meticulous with an eye for beauty, suited to jobs needing care, like design, customer care or bookkeeping.
sang.de_vap: You do good work but rarely talk about it, so you easily get overlooked for raises or big assignments.
sang.loi_khuyen: At the end of each month, send your boss a few lines summarising what you finished and the concrete results.

ham.manh: You work carefully with few small errors, suited to quiet jobs that need precision.
ham.de_vap: When criticised in front of others, you easily feel down all day and lose heart in the work.
ham.loi_khuyen: When your boss gives feedback, note exactly one thing to fix, say thank you, and leave the feelings to think about at home.

sang.manh: You value your nest, know how to make a home cosy, and usually manage to save up for a place of your own.
sang.de_vap: You can get so attached to home that you resist change, even when moving would be better for your work.
sang.loi_khuyen: Keep a separate savings fund for housing, and once a year look again at whether your current home still suits you.

ham.manh: You can turn a small corner into a comfortable spot — some plants and warm light are all it takes.
ham.de_vap: An unsettled living situation makes you uneasy, and you may rush into renting or buying just to have a calm place.
ham.loi_khuyen: Before signing a lease or buying, visit at least twice at different times of day and read every line of the contract.

sang.manh: You know how to calm yourself with small things — music, plants, a walk — so you're rarely swept up in noisy drama.
sang.de_vap: You tend to carry your thoughts alone, replaying old events many times even when they're long past.
sang.loi_khuyen: Keep up a hands-on hobby like drawing, gardening or cooking, at least twice a week.

ham.manh: You sense beauty in things others overlook, and that's your own private joy.
ham.de_vap: On nights when you feel low for no clear reason, you easily think you're less lucky than others, and the more you think, the lower you sink.
ham.loi_khuyen: When you feel sad without knowing why, go for a twenty-minute walk or call a friend, rather than lying in bed scrolling.

sang.manh: You're close to your mother or whoever cared for you most, learned thoughtfulness from them, and know how to make your parents happy with small gestures.
sang.de_vap: You easily let your parents' feelings affect you; one sad remark from your mother can leave you troubled for days.
sang.loi_khuyen: Call home at a fixed time each week and ask about something specific in your parents' lives, not just "are you well?".

ham.manh: You understand what your parents find hard to say, so you know when to sit beside them instead of arguing.
ham.de_vap: You and your parents easily misunderstand each other because everyone keeps things inside, then sulk through veiled remarks.
ham.loi_khuyen: When something is off with your parents, pick a calm moment and start with "I feel" rather than "you always".

sang.manh: You love life, learn anything quickly and always have something to talk about, so new people easily notice and like you.
sang.de_vap: You open many things at once, throw yourself in when inspired, then get bored and leave a few projects half done.
sang.loi_khuyen: Before starting a new hobby or course, write down one unfinished thing you need to finish first.

ham.manh: You have strong vitality; however tired you are, you still feel like going out, meeting friends and trying new food.
ham.de_vap: Desires come fast and are hard to stop; one game or one drinking session easily runs late into the night and leaves you tired the next day.
ham.loi_khuyen: Before each night out, set a time to go home or a maximum amount to spend, and ask a friend to remind you if you go over.

sang.manh: With siblings and friends, you're the one who rallies people and comes up with plans, making get-togethers much more fun.
sang.de_vap: You tend to have fun together more than look after each other, so when someone needs support they hesitate to ask.
sang.loi_khuyen: Among your siblings, ask each one privately a heartfelt question at least once a month.

ham.manh: You fit into any group easily; siblings and friends all feel relaxed around you.
ham.de_vap: Pooling money and borrowing things with siblings easily gets messy because everyone assumes being close means no need to spell things out.
ham.loi_khuyen: Record every money exchange with your siblings, however small, in a shared note on your phone.

sang.manh: In love you're fun, good at planning fresh dates, so your partner rarely gets bored.
sang.de_vap: You need novelty, so when the relationship settles into routine you easily feel bored without saying so.
sang.loi_khuyen: Each month, try one thing with your partner you've never done together, like cooking an unusual dish or exploring a new street.

ham.manh: You know how to make your partner laugh and the small tricks that lighten the mood at home.
ham.de_vap: You easily get absorbed in your own hobbies or friends, leaving your partner feeling they come after many other things.
ham.loi_khuyen: Keep one evening a week just for the two of you, phones off, and ask what happy or sad things happened to them this week.

sang.manh: You play with your children like a big friend, teach through games and let them try many things.
sang.de_vap: You may sign your child up for too many extra classes because everything looks good, tiring them out without letting them go deep.
sang.loi_khuyen: Each year, choose one or two main interests with your child, and ask honestly which one they like most.

ham.manh: You're easy for your children to approach; they find you fun and often tell you about school.
ham.de_vap: You may indulge your child depending on your mood, easy one day and strict the next, so they don't know where the limits are.
ham.loi_khuyen: Agree on three clear rules with your child, stick them on the fridge and keep to them even on days you're in a good mood.

sang.manh: You have a knack for earning through connections — good at selling, seizing opportunities and juggling several income sources.
sang.de_vap: Money comes in fast but goes out just as fast; after pay day it's eating out, shopping and inviting friends out.
sang.loi_khuyen: On pay day, move part of it into a separate account that's hard to withdraw from, then spend the rest.

ham.manh: You're quick to spot chances to earn extra and aren't afraid to try new ways of making money.
ham.de_vap: You can get swept up in get-rich-quick offers, or spend lavishly on expensive pleasures.
ham.loi_khuyen: For investment offers promising high returns, ask someone who knows finance first, and only put in money your family wouldn't miss if it were lost.

sang.manh: You have fairly good stamina; even after lots of fun or work, you bounce back after a night's sleep.
sang.de_vap: You tend to eat on a whim and stay up late for fun, thinking you're still strong so it doesn't matter.
sang.loi_khuyen: Limit parties to two a week, and after any late night, catch up with at least an extra hour of sleep.

ham.manh: Once you find a form of exercise you enjoy, you stick with it because you love the light feeling after a session.
ham.de_vap: Your daily rhythm easily slips because of long nights out, late-night eating, heavy drinking and little sleep.
ham.loi_khuyen: Choose a form of exercise you can do with friends, like badminton or a running group, so good habits become a social outing too.

sang.manh: Out in the world you're very likeable; wherever you go, you make acquaintances, business contacts or new friends.
sang.de_vap: You easily accept too many appointments, running from one place to another until there's no time left for your main work.
sang.loi_khuyen: Each week, accept only the number of appointments you've set in advance, and prioritise people who help you move forward in your main work.

ham.manh: You're bold in unfamiliar places, dare to start conversations and try things, so you learn a lot from the outside world.
ham.de_vap: In environments full of temptation, you easily get carried along by the crowd and spend more money and time than planned.
ham.loi_khuyen: Before a long trip or a party, write down your budget and when you'll head home, then stick to it.

sang.manh: You know a lot of people, so whatever you need there's someone to introduce you, and you're happy to introduce others too.
sang.de_vap: You have many friends, but mostly fun friends; when things get truly hard, few stay.
sang.loi_khuyen: Make a list of five friends you truly trust, and meet each one privately at least once a quarter.

ham.manh: People readily invite you out, so you're never short of places to go or people to see.
ham.de_vap: Friends easily draw you into expensive outings or things you don't really want to do.
ham.loi_khuyen: Practise a short refusal like "I can't make it this time", without needing a long explanation.

sang.manh: At work you're a good communicator, suited to sales, media or service — jobs where people need to like you.
sang.de_vap: You're good at many things, so you easily switch jobs when somewhere else looks more appealing, before going deep anywhere.
sang.loi_khuyen: Before changing jobs, ask yourself whether you've learned everything you needed to where you are, and write the answer down.

ham.manh: You're flexible, can handle urgent tasks and know how to keep clients or your boss happy.
ham.de_vap: You tend to put your energy into the fun, people-facing parts, and leave paperwork and details until late.
ham.loi_khuyen: Each morning, do the most boring part of your work before opening your messages, even if only for thirty minutes.

sang.manh: You like a lively home, often invite friends over to eat and know how to make where you live a happy place.
sang.de_vap: You tend to spend a lot on decorations, gadgets and renovations on a whim rather than on need.
sang.loi_khuyen: Whenever you want to buy something for the home, put it on a waiting list and only buy it if you still want it two weeks later.

ham.manh: You adapt easily to new places; whether moving house or renting a room, you settle in quickly.
ham.de_vap: Your home easily gets messy when you're busy having fun outside, and you buy lots of things you rarely use.
ham.loi_khuyen: Each weekend, spend fifteen minutes tidying one corner, and give away one thing you haven't used in the past three months.

sang.manh: You know how to enjoy life; a good meal or a short trip is enough to lift you after a tiring week.
sang.de_vap: When you're sad you tend to seek fun outside, rarely sitting still to understand what's actually upsetting you.
sang.loi_khuyen: When you notice you want to go out to forget something, sit for five minutes and write it down first, then go.

ham.manh: You have many interests, so when you tire of one thing there's always another to cheer you up.
ham.de_vap: You find it hard to feel you have enough; once you have something you want more, so joy comes fast and goes fast.
ham.loi_khuyen: Each night before bed, write down three things from the day that made you feel you had enough, even just a good cup of coffee.

sang.manh: You talk easily with your parents or boss, know how to make them laugh, and they often give you freedom to do things your way.
sang.de_vap: You tend to make promises to your parents and then forget because of your own plans, like promising to come home for a weekend meal and missing it.
sang.loi_khuyen: Put visits or calls to your parents in your phone calendar like a work appointment, and keep them.

ham.manh: You're relaxed with your parents and talk freely, so they feel close to you.
ham.de_vap: Your parents or boss may see you as fun-loving and not yet mature, even though you actually handle your responsibilities properly.
ham.loi_khuyen: Take the initiative to tell your parents or boss about a concrete plan you're working on, with a deadline, to put them at ease.

sang.manh: You speak with reason and analyse everything thoroughly, so when you need to persuade someone, people usually listen.
sang.de_vap: You often ask why and are quick to spot flaws in what others say, making them feel scrutinised even though you just want clarity.
sang.loi_khuyen: Before challenging someone, first say one thing you agree with, then raise what you think isn't right.

ham.manh: You see what doesn't add up where others miss it, and you aren't easily led by sweet words.
ham.de_vap: Your blunt words are easily mistaken for criticism, and you also tend to suspect others of bad intentions toward you.
ham.loi_khuyen: When you suspect someone, check with one direct question to that person before telling a third party.

sang.manh: With your siblings you're the straight talker who dares to speak up when family matters need discussing, helping everyone see the problem clearly.
sang.de_vap: Family discussions easily become contests over who's right.
sang.loi_khuyen: When discussing shared matters with your siblings, write the options on paper and let everyone finish before deciding.

ham.manh: You see the things siblings hesitate to say, and can be the one to untangle the knot if you choose your words well.
ham.de_vap: A careless remark between siblings can be brought up for years, becoming an old grievance that's hard to clear.
ham.loi_khuyen: If you have an issue with a sibling, talk to that person directly, not through a third party.

sang.manh: In love you like things said clearly, and the two of you can sort out almost anything by sitting down and talking.
sang.de_vap: When you argue, you easily win the point but lose the heart — right in what you say, yet hurtful to your partner.
sang.loi_khuyen: When you argue, swap "you're wrong" for "I feel hurt when…", then stop and listen to their reply.

ham.manh: You pay close attention to your partner's words, so you easily notice when there's something they find hard to say.
ham.de_vap: You can be suspicious, reading other meanings into an ordinary sentence, then pressing with questions that wear your partner out.
ham.loi_khuyen: When something your partner says makes you suspicious, ask back exactly once: is this what you meant?

sang.manh: You teach your children through reasoning, explaining why instead of giving orders, so they learn how to think.
sang.de_vap: Your child may often argue back, and you can easily turn dinner into a debate about who's right.
sang.loi_khuyen: When your child argues, ask what they think would be reasonable, then pick one approach together to try for a week.

ham.manh: You notice when your child is hiding something, and can help if you ask in a gentle voice.
ham.de_vap: You can speak harshly when your child does wrong, and they remember those words long after you've forgotten.
ham.loi_khuyen: When you're annoyed with your child, wait ten minutes before speaking, and end with a sentence that lets them know you still love them.

sang.manh: You earn well through expertise and words, such as advising, teaching, selling or negotiating.
sang.de_vap: In business you easily trust verbal promises, then argue when the two sides remember things differently.
sang.loi_khuyen: Close every money agreement, even with people you know, with a message stating the amount, the deadline and each side's part.

ham.manh: You scrutinise contracts and are rarely fooled by offers that sound too good.
ham.de_vap: Money easily gets tangled in arguments, debt chasing or unclear shares, costing you both money and friendships.
ham.loi_khuyen: Never lend or co-invest on a verbal basis; every sum gets a written note or a bank transfer with a clear description.

sang.manh: You take the trouble to learn about your health, ask the right questions at check-ups and follow advice that makes sense.
sang.de_vap: Your mind runs non-stop, going over the same thing so much that it tires you more than work does.
sang.loi_khuyen: Each day, take a ten-minute walk without headphones to give your mind a break from analysing.

ham.manh: You notice early when you're stressed, because it shows right away in how you speak and sleep.
ham.de_vap: Anxiety easily builds up; you carry things alone and lie awake at night imagining worst-case scenarios.
ham.loi_khuyen: When a worry keeps coming back, tell someone you trust; have regular check-ups for peace of mind instead of guessing.

sang.manh: Out in the world you're strongest where reasoning is needed — negotiating, presenting, debating — and people respect you.
sang.de_vap: In a new environment you may debate too early, before anyone understands you, making people wary.
sang.loi_khuyen: In a new place, spend the first week mostly asking and listening, note what you think isn't working, and give feedback the following week.

ham.manh: You're careful with strangers, so you're rarely taken advantage of when travelling or working with new partners.
ham.de_vap: Out and about you can easily get caught up in gossip, with a joke retold with a different meaning.
ham.loi_khuyen: In crowded settings, avoid commenting on people who aren't there, even when everyone else is talking about them.

sang.manh: You choose friends carefully, and the friends you keep are usually people you can be honest with.
sang.de_vap: In groups of friends or colleagues you easily get drawn into gossip, then your words get passed on wrongly.
sang.loi_khuyen: When someone badmouths another person to you, just listen, don't add anything, and change the subject.

ham.manh: You can tell who is two-faced, so you rarely get drawn into insincere groups.
ham.de_vap: You easily suspect colleagues or friends of talking behind your back, and the suspicion slowly cools the relationship.
ham.loi_khuyen: When you hear a rumour about yourself, ask the person concerned directly and calmly before reacting.

sang.manh: You suit professions that live on words and reasoning: law, education, consulting, media, research.
sang.de_vap: You tend to argue with your boss in big meetings — right on the point, but making your boss lose face.
sang.loi_khuyen: Raise disagreements with your boss privately after the meeting, opening with: I have a different angle I'd like you to look at.

ham.manh: You spot flaws in plans very quickly, suited to checking, reviewing and research work.
ham.de_vap: Gossip or misunderstandings easily surround you at work, especially when you give feedback at the wrong moment.
ham.loi_khuyen: For every important task your boss gives you verbally, send back a short summary message so you both understand it the same way.

sang.manh: You research thoroughly before renting or buying a home, read every clause and ask all the questions that need asking.
sang.de_vap: Home matters easily spark family arguments, with everyone having their own ideas about repairs or dividing things.
sang.loi_khuyen: When discussing the home with family, write all opinions on a shared sheet and set a separate meeting to decide.

ham.manh: You're careful with property paperwork, which saves you from many problems others run into.
ham.de_vap: Home matters can bring unclear paperwork or disagreements with neighbours or landlords over things only agreed verbally.
ham.loi_khuyen: With landlords or neighbours, follow up anything agreed with a message that same day.

sang.manh: You like to dig deep and read widely, and feel at peace when you fully understand something you wondered about.
sang.de_vap: Your mind rarely rests; an unanswered question keeps you tossing and turning.
sang.loi_khuyen: Keep a notebook of the questions on your mind; once you've written one down, allow yourself to set it aside until tomorrow.

ham.manh: You don't simply follow the crowd and always check for yourself before accepting something.
ham.de_vap: You can doubt even the good things that come your way, so it's hard to feel at ease even when all is well.
ham.loi_khuyen: When something good happens, say thank you before looking for the reason it happened.

sang.manh: You dare to talk frankly with your parents or boss, and when your reasoning is clear they usually listen.
sang.de_vap: You and your parents easily argue about how to live, with something to fight about every visit home.
sang.loi_khuyen: Each visit home, pick one topic to leave alone, and spend time asking about your parents' old days.

ham.manh: You understand what your parents or boss leave unsaid, and know how to read between the lines.
ham.de_vap: Feedback from your parents or boss easily sounds to you like criticism, and you react sharply.
ham.loi_khuyen: When your parents or boss give feedback, restate their point in your own words before replying, to make sure you've understood.

sang.manh: You're fair, keep your word, and are often the one who mediates when two sides disagree without anyone losing face.
sang.de_vap: You care so much about keeping the peace and everyone's face that you rarely say what you really want.
sang.loi_khuyen: This week, pick one small matter and state your own wish clearly before asking what others think.

ham.manh: You're kind, understanding and always want to help people in difficulty.
ham.de_vap: You're easily persuaded by people close to you to do things their way, then end up carrying trouble that isn't yours.
ham.loi_khuyen: When someone asks you to vouch for them or speak on their behalf, promise an answer the next day so you have time to think.

sang.manh: You're a sibling people trust; anyone with a problem comes to you to speak up for them with the whole family.
sang.de_vap: You often stand in the middle, taking on all the peacemaking until you're worn out yourself.
sang.loi_khuyen: When a sibling asks you to speak to someone for them, encourage them to say it themselves first, with you just sitting beside them.

ham.manh: You're willing to help your siblings in hard times, even when it costs you your own time.
ham.de_vap: Out of love for your siblings, you easily take on their debts or burdens and end up in a tight spot yourself.
ham.loi_khuyen: Set yourself a maximum amount of money help for your siblings, and say clearly whether it's a gift or a loan.

sang.manh: You respect your partner and know how to protect their dignity in front of both families and friends.
sang.de_vap: You tend to keep up a smooth appearance, not mentioning unhappy things, and over time it becomes distance.
sang.loi_khuyen: Each week, ask your partner one specific question: is there anything this week you'd like me to do differently?

ham.manh: You indulge your partner and are willing to give way to keep the peace at home.
ham.de_vap: You easily let your partner or both families decide for you, then quietly feel short-changed.
ham.loi_khuyen: For big decisions like buying a home or changing jobs, give your view before hearing anyone else's.

sang.manh: You teach your children manners and treat them fairly, and they usually grow up knowing how to behave.
sang.de_vap: You tend to focus more on how your child looks in others' eyes than on how your child actually feels.
sang.loi_khuyen: After each family gathering, ask your child privately: did you feel comfortable today?

ham.manh: You're gentle with your children, so they can talk to you without fear of being scolded.
ham.de_vap: You tend to give in to your child's demands to keep things calm, then find it hard to set limits again.
ham.loi_khuyen: When your child asks for something you don't think is right, say "no" once, calmly, then briefly explain why.

sang.manh: You keep money steadily and transparently, suited to stable income, and are often trusted to manage shared money.
sang.de_vap: You tend to spend for appearances — gifts, parties, nice things — more than you really need.
sang.loi_khuyen: Set a fixed monthly budget for gifts and weddings or funerals, and record each item to review at month's end.

ham.manh: You're willing to share when others are in need, so there are often people around you who remember your kindness.
ham.de_vap: You easily borrow on someone's behalf, act as guarantor or chip in at an acquaintance's request, and your own money gets stuck.
ham.loi_khuyen: Don't sign as guarantor or take out a loan in your name for anyone without talking to your household and reading the papers carefully.

sang.manh: You live fairly moderately, eat and sleep on schedule, and keep good routines when things are going well.
sang.de_vap: You tend to look after others first, skipping meals or staying up late to help someone, and wear yourself out.
sang.loi_khuyen: Keep one meal a day where you sit and eat properly, with no work and no phone calls, however busy you are.

ham.manh: When someone reminds you, you're willing to change habits, so having an exercise buddy helps you a lot.
ham.de_vap: You easily absorb other people's stress and feel tired without knowing why.
ham.loi_khuyen: After a day of hearing a lot of other people's troubles, take fifteen minutes for a warm shower or a walk before doing housework.

sang.manh: Out in the world you're trusted; strangers easily give you tasks because you're neat and keep your word.
sang.de_vap: You tend to agree to be the go-between for other people's business, adding work without adding benefit.
sang.loi_khuyen: When asked to be a go-between, ask clearly where your part ends, and say so from the start.

ham.manh: You're polite and know how to behave in unfamiliar places, so you rarely upset anyone.
ham.de_vap: In a new place you're easily led along by smooth talkers, agreeing first and only then realising it doesn't suit you.
ham.loi_khuyen: In a new environment, answer every partnership offer with "let me think it over", and ask someone you know before saying yes.

sang.manh: You treat colleagues and team members fairly, so people respect you and cooperate easily.
sang.de_vap: You dislike upsetting people, so you're slow to speak up when someone on the team isn't doing well.
sang.loi_khuyen: When you need to remind a colleague, do it privately, name one specific thing and a deadline to fix it, without beating around the bush.

ham.manh: You're approachable; everyone on the team feels they can ask you for help.
ham.de_vap: You're easily swayed by outspoken friends, going along with them even when you disagree inside.
ham.loi_khuyen: Before each team meeting, write your own view on paper so others' views don't sweep it away.

sang.manh: You suit management, coordination or HR roles, where a fair person is needed to keep things on track.
sang.de_vap: You're good at helping others succeed but rarely claim credit for yourself.
sang.loi_khuyen: When a project you coordinated is done, state clearly what you did in the report to your boss.

ham.manh: You do well in support roles, careful and thorough with paperwork and procedures.
ham.de_vap: Out of courtesy, you easily take the blame for others' mistakes and get judged unfairly.
ham.loi_khuyen: For every extra task you take from a colleague, send a message confirming who is responsible for which part.

sang.manh: You keep a tidy, orderly home and are often the one who handles the property paperwork for the whole family.
sang.de_vap: You tend to spend a lot on making the home look good for guests, while the spaces you use every day aren't yet convenient.
sang.loi_khuyen: Before renovating, list the three most inconvenient spots in daily life and fix those first.

ham.manh: You know how to get on with neighbours and landlords, so there's rarely friction where you live.
ham.de_vap: You tend to hold property in your name for someone or let relatives stay without stating a time limit, then find it hard to bring up.
ham.loi_khuyen: When letting someone stay or holding something in your name for them, state the time limit and conditions from the start and confirm by message.

sang.manh: You feel at peace when you live by what's right, and rarely have to agonise over what you've done.
sang.de_vap: You tend to carry responsibility for the whole family or group, so you rarely let yourself truly rest.
sang.loi_khuyen: Each month, have one day when you don't agree to help anyone and just do what you enjoy.

ham.manh: You have a kind heart and feel happy when you can help others.
ham.de_vap: You tend to care what others think of you, doing many things out of fear of upsetting people rather than because you want to.
ham.loi_khuyen: Before agreeing to something, ask yourself: if no one knew I'd done it, would I still want to?

sang.manh: You respect your parents and superiors and behave properly, so they often trust you with tasks.
sang.de_vap: You tend to go along with your parents' wishes on big decisions in your life, then regret it later.
sang.loi_khuyen: For a big decision, after hearing your parents out, write down your own reasons before giving them your answer.

ham.manh: You know how to give way to your parents and keep the atmosphere at home warm.
ham.de_vap: You tend to end up between your parents and other family members, speaking up for each side until you're exhausted.
ham.loi_khuyen: When you're pulled into something between your parents and someone else, say gently: I love you both, please talk to each other directly.

sang.manh: You're calm, keep your composure when things get messy, and people often come to you for advice.
sang.de_vap: You tend to explain when people just need to be heard, making them feel lectured.
sang.loi_khuyen: When someone tells you something, ask first: do you want me to listen, or do you want my advice?

ham.manh: You have a good heart and want the people around you to live rightly and decently.
ham.de_vap: You tend to step into other people's affairs before being asked, then feel hurt when they don't listen.
ham.loi_khuyen: Only give advice when asked; if you're really worried, ask one question: is there anything I can do to help?

sang.manh: Among your siblings you're like the eldest; anyone in trouble comes to you first.
sang.de_vap: You tend to take on looking after the whole family, then get annoyed when the younger ones don't do as you say.
sang.loi_khuyen: Next time a sibling asks your view, give two or three options and let them choose, even if you see one clearly better.

ham.manh: You're willing to shield your siblings when they stumble and leave no one behind.
ham.de_vap: You easily feel lonely among your siblings, as if only you care while the others don't.
ham.loi_khuyen: Invite your siblings to do something fun with no responsibilities attached, like sharing a meal or watching a match.

sang.manh: You're a steady support for your partner; when they're in a muddle, you're the one who stays calm.
sang.de_vap: You tend to play the grown-up in the relationship, reminding and instructing, so your partner feels managed.
sang.loi_khuyen: For one week, try not commenting on your partner's small things, and praise one thing they did well each day.

ham.manh: You take love seriously and want to protect the person you love.
ham.de_vap: You can feel distant from your partner because you move at different paces — you plan ahead while they live for today.
ham.loi_khuyen: Each week, spend one session doing something your partner enjoys, even if it doesn't seem useful to you.

sang.manh: You're your child's first teacher, teaching right from wrong, and always the place they come back to.
sang.de_vap: You tend to teach too much — a lesson at every meal — so your child hesitates to share things.
sang.loi_khuyen: Each evening, ask your child about one happy thing from the day and just listen, saving lessons for another time.

ham.manh: You protect your children fiercely and always stand by them when they need you.
ham.de_vap: You tend to make many decisions for your child, from friends to subjects of study, so it's hard for them to stand on their own.
ham.loi_khuyen: Give your child one thing to decide each week, like the weekend meal, and respect their choice.

sang.manh: You earn steadily from expertise, advising or teaching — work people trust you with because of your credibility.
sang.de_vap: You tend to avoid talking about price, doing a lot of help for little or nothing.
sang.loi_khuyen: Write a price list for the work you're often asked to do, and send it before you start.

ham.manh: You know how to live simply and feel you have enough without much money.
ham.de_vap: You tend to use money to look after others or lend to relatives, then come up short when you need it yourself.
ham.loi_khuyen: Keep a reserve worth three months of spending, and don't touch it to help anyone.

sang.manh: You handle pressure well, stay calm when things get hard, and rarely let stress drag on.
sang.de_vap: You tend to take on other people's worries, lying awake at night thinking about friends and family.
sang.loi_khuyen: Each night before bed, turn off your phone and read a few pages or stretch for ten minutes to calm your mind.

ham.manh: When you take advice on board, you keep good habits for a long time because you believe in discipline.
ham.de_vap: You can be complacent about your own body, telling others to get checked while putting it off yourself.
ham.loi_khuyen: Book your yearly check-up in the same month every year, like your birthday month, so you don't forget.

sang.manh: Out in the world you often meet people who help at the right moment, and you're often the one helping strangers too.
sang.de_vap: When travelling, you tend to take charge of the whole group and forget that you need rest too.
sang.loi_khuyen: On your next trip, divide tasks clearly among everyone in advance, and give yourself one session with nothing to worry about.

ham.manh: You like travelling and learn a lot from faraway places.
ham.de_vap: Far from home you can easily feel isolated, keep to yourself and have few people to confide in.
ham.loi_khuyen: In a new place, join a regular group activity, such as a book club or a running group.

sang.manh: Friends and colleagues trust you like an older sibling, and many remember the advice you gave.
sang.de_vap: You easily become the one who handles everything for the group; everyone leans on you and few support you back.
sang.loi_khuyen: When the group faces a task, assign each part to a person instead of taking it all on, and check progress later.

ham.manh: You're happy to help newcomers and generous in showing them the ropes.
ham.de_vap: You tend to instruct colleagues on your own level, so they feel you're a little condescending even though you don't mean it.
ham.loi_khuyen: With colleagues on your level, swap "you should" for "I once did it this way — see if it works for you".

sang.manh: You suit work that needs credibility and integrity: education, healthcare, consulting, law, HR management.
sang.de_vap: You tend to shy away from competition, letting others take the good assignments even when you'd do them better.
sang.loi_khuyen: When there's a role or project you want, tell your boss that same week with one or two concrete reasons.

ham.manh: You work by principle and aren't easily drawn into shady dealings at work.
ham.de_vap: You easily disagree with your boss when you see things being done wrong, and say so as if lecturing a superior.
ham.loi_khuyen: When you disagree with your boss, offer a concrete alternative instead of only pointing out what's wrong.

sang.manh: Your home is often where relatives and friends gather, and you keep a stable place to live with little upheaval.
sang.de_vap: You tend to carry the whole extended family's home duties, from memorial days to repairs, and hesitate to ask for help.
sang.loi_khuyen: Set up a family group chat to divide tasks for memorial days and Tet, writing down who does what.

ham.manh: You can live in a simple place and feel fine without a big house.
ham.de_vap: Where you live may change many times, or you may live far from family for long stretches and rarely visit.
ham.loi_khuyen: Wherever you are, keep a fixed spot for important things and a fixed schedule for visiting home each quarter.

sang.manh: You have inner steadiness; even after big events you find a way to get back up.
sang.de_vap: You rarely allow yourself to be weak, telling everyone you're fine even when you also need comfort.
sang.loi_khuyen: Choose a friend you trust and, once a month, be honest with them about what's wearing you down.

ham.manh: You have clear principles to live by, so you rarely lose your way.
ham.de_vap: You easily feel alone, as if no one understands what you worry about.
ham.loi_khuyen: Each week, meet someone outside of work for a drink and a chat with no particular purpose.

sang.manh: Your parents or superiors protect you, and you return it with respect.
sang.de_vap: You tend to advise your parents back on how to live, making them feel their child is lecturing them.
sang.loi_khuyen: When you want your parents to change a habit, tell them about someone else who did it instead of saying "you should".

ham.manh: You became independent early and rarely need to lean on your parents for your own affairs.
ham.de_vap: You and your parents can grow apart in distance or outlook, with little in common to talk about.
ham.loi_khuyen: Each week, send your parents a photo or a short story from your day, so there's something to keep the conversation going.

sang.manh: You're decisive; faced with a hard task, you roll up your sleeves right away and can handle pressure that many avoid.
sang.de_vap: You tend to decide quickly before you have enough information, then have to redo things, costing more than waiting another day.
sang.loi_khuyen: For big decisions, set yourself a rule: ask someone who knows the field and sleep on it before settling.

ham.manh: You have strong willpower; wherever you fall, you get back up, and you don't give up easily.
ham.de_vap: When heated, you easily say or do things you regret, especially when cornered.
ham.loi_khuyen: When you feel yourself heating up, leave the room for a glass of water and count to ten before replying.

sang.manh: With your siblings, you're the one who steps up when the family faces something big; one word from you and everyone feels reassured.
sang.de_vap: You tend to decide for your siblings, speaking as if giving orders, so they feel they weren't consulted.
sang.loi_khuyen: Before settling a shared family matter, ask each person "what do you think?" before giving your own view.

ham.manh: You're independent, rarely need to lean on your siblings, and take care of your own share.
ham.de_vap: You and your siblings easily clash because everyone is stubborn; one big argument can drive you apart for a long time.
ham.loi_khuyen: After an argument with a sibling, send a friendly message within three days, without bringing up the past.

sang.manh: You suit a partner with personality, and together you can take on big things like building a house or opening a shop.
sang.de_vap: You can both want to be in the driver's seat, so even small things turn into a contest over who decides.
sang.loi_khuyen: Agree clearly with your partner who leads on which area, for example you handle household money and they handle the children.

ham.manh: You love sincerely and dare to do a lot for the person you love.
ham.de_vap: In arguments you can say harsh things or demand to end it right away, then regret it afterwards.
ham.loi_khuyen: Agree in advance with your partner: when angry, neither of you talks about ending things; take an hour's break before continuing.

sang.manh: You teach your children to be bold and try things, and they usually grow up strong and independent.
sang.de_vap: You can be strict and set high expectations, so your child fears doing wrong more than they want to do well.
sang.loi_khuyen: Each time your child gets something wrong, ask "what will you do next time?" before saying what you're unhappy about.

ham.manh: You respect your child's individuality and don't force them to be like anyone else.
ham.de_vap: You and your child can be equally stubborn, arguing to the end with neither giving way.
ham.loi_khuyen: When things are tense with your child, be the first to lower your voice, and agree to continue after dinner.

sang.manh: You dare to do business and take on hard work to earn, and at times your income rises quickly thanks to your nerve.
sang.de_vap: You tend to pour all your money into one opportunity because you believe you can make it work, leaving no way back.
sang.loi_khuyen: For each investment, put in at most a third of the money you have, keeping the rest as an emergency fund.

ham.manh: You earn money through your own effort and don't mind hard work.
ham.de_vap: Your finances easily swing up and down because of hasty decisions — sometimes plenty, sometimes short.
ham.loi_khuyen: Before a big expense, write down the worst case and ask yourself whether you could handle it, then decide.

sang.manh: You're physically strong and can handle spells of intense work while staying on your feet.
sang.de_vap: You often work until you're drained before resting, brushing off small aches or lingering tiredness.
sang.loi_khuyen: When doing sport or heavy work, warm up properly and stop as soon as your body signals pain, without pushing on.

ham.manh: You recover fairly quickly when you rest properly.
ham.de_vap: You tend to rush through daily life — walking fast, working fast, eating in a hurry — so you often bump into things and get tired.
ham.loi_khuyen: Practise slowing down at the moments you rush most: driving, going up and down stairs, handling a knife in the kitchen.

sang.manh: Out in the world you dare to go far and into tough environments, and often open up paths where others hesitate.
sang.de_vap: You tend to rush into new places without researching them, then run into unwritten rules.
sang.loi_khuyen: Before going to a new workplace or city, talk to at least two people who have been there.

ham.manh: You adapt quickly to hard, under-resourced places and don't mind starting from zero.
ham.de_vap: Out in the world you easily clash with strangers because you're blunt, and small things become big.
ham.loi_khuyen: On the street or in crowds, when there's friction, choose to apologise first even if you don't think you were entirely wrong.

sang.manh: You can lead a team; colleagues and team members often follow you because you dare to take on hard tasks.
sang.de_vap: You tend to expect others to work as fast and hard as you, then get annoyed when they can't keep up.
sang.loi_khuyen: When assigning work, ask how long the person needs and agree on a deadline you can both live with.

ham.manh: You're straightforward; friends know exactly what you think without having to guess.
ham.de_vap: Relationships with friends and colleagues can get tense at times because you speak bluntly without softening it.
ham.loi_khuyen: Before giving a colleague feedback, praise one thing they did well first, then say what needs fixing.

sang.manh: You suit work that takes nerve: opening markets, business, engineering, handling crises — high-pressure places.
sang.de_vap: You tend to work alone, take everything on and dislike waiting for others, so it's hard to keep a team for long.
sang.loi_khuyen: Each week, spend a session listening to your team's difficulties, and hand back at least one task you've been holding.

ham.manh: You can handle heavy and urgent work, and don't mind starting over when needed.
ham.de_vap: Your work can swing sharply because you change direction in a hurry or disagree with your superiors.
ham.loi_khuyen: Before quitting or changing direction, wait a full two weeks and talk it over with a friend you trust.

sang.manh: You dare to make home decisions — buying, moving, renovating — quickly when the timing feels right.
sang.de_vap: You tend to decide on home matters alone; before the household has agreed, you've already put down a deposit.
sang.loi_khuyen: For every decision to buy, sell or move, talk it over with the household at least twice before putting down a deposit.

ham.manh: You aren't too attached to where you live, so you're willing to move when work requires it.
ham.de_vap: Where you live may change often, and you can live makeshift for a long time because you don't feel the need to settle.
ham.loi_khuyen: Even when renting, invest in a really good place to sleep and keep the home tidy, so you have a true place to rest each night.

sang.manh: You have a strong spirit; when things get hard, you feel the need to stand up rather than sit and complain.
sang.de_vap: You find it hard to sit still and feel guilty resting, so you rarely truly relax.
sang.loi_khuyen: Choose an active way to rest, like hiking, swimming or cycling, so you get to move and rest at the same time.

ham.manh: You've built willpower through hard times, and that's what others respect in you.
ham.de_vap: Inside, you often feel unsettled, as if always bracing for a hard fight.
ham.loi_khuyen: Each day, spend ten minutes breathing slowly or listening to a familiar song, just so your body knows it's safe.

sang.manh: You became independent early and decide your own life, and your parents or superiors often respect your determination.
sang.de_vap: You and your parents or boss easily clash because everyone wants to be the one who decides.
sang.loi_khuyen: When you disagree with your parents or boss, ask what worries them most, then answer exactly that.

ham.manh: You stand on your own two feet and don't wait for anyone to shelter you.
ham.de_vap: You tend to react strongly when your parents or boss impose on you; one remark and both sides go cold for days.
ham.loi_khuyen: When you feel imposed upon, say "let me think about it" instead of refusing straight away, then answer the next day.

sang.manh: You dare to change; when the old way isn't working you start over, and you often open up new ways others hadn't thought of.
sang.de_vap: You easily get bored once things settle into routine, wanting to start over even when a task is halfway done.
sang.loi_khuyen: Before dropping something to start over, write down three things you learned from it and one thing you could keep.

ham.manh: You're not afraid of change; whatever you lose, you can start again from scratch.
ham.de_vap: You can be impulsive and leave many things unfinished, making others hesitant to give you long-term tasks.
ham.loi_khuyen: Choose one task this month and see it through to the end, even if you get bored halfway, before starting anything new.

sang.manh: With your siblings, you're the one bringing new ideas, encouraging the family to change how they work and live.
sang.de_vap: Your bond with your siblings comes and goes in phases; you easily get busy with your own life and forget to check in.
sang.loi_khuyen: Set a monthly reminder to call each sibling, even for just five minutes.

ham.manh: You're independent, with a path quite different from your siblings', and you don't mind being different.
ham.de_vap: Money matters or joint ventures with siblings easily collapse halfway, damaging your relationship.
ham.loi_khuyen: If you go into business with a sibling, write a clear agreement from the start, including how to pull out if you no longer want to continue.

sang.manh: In love you always want to keep things fresh, introducing changes so the two of you don't get bored.
sang.de_vap: You tend to want change faster than your partner can keep up with, like moving house or changing jobs, without asking enough.
sang.loi_khuyen: Before proposing a big change, ask your partner: how long do you need to think about this?

ham.manh: You dare to speak honestly about what isn't working in the relationship, without pretending for the sake of peace.
ham.de_vap: When bored or angry, you tend to want to tear down the whole relationship and start over instead of fixing one thing.
ham.loi_khuyen: When you feel bored, write down exactly one thing that needs to change and discuss only that with your partner.

sang.manh: You give your children freedom to try different things, and they usually grow up creative and bold in their thinking.
sang.de_vap: You tend to keep changing how you parent, strict one day and soft the next, so your child struggles to know what's fixed.
sang.loi_khuyen: Agree with your partner on three parenting principles, and keep them steady for at least six months.

ham.manh: You understand strong-willed children and don't force your child into a mould.
ham.de_vap: Household plans change constantly, so your child feels things are always in upheaval.
ham.loi_khuyen: Keep one fixed routine for your child each day, like a shared dinner time, even when other things change.

sang.manh: You dare to change how you earn, with the bounce to start over when one income source no longer fits.
sang.de_vap: Money flows in and out strongly; you tend to spend big on a new idea before the old one has had time to pay off.
sang.loi_khuyen: Keep a six-month emergency fund in a separate account, and use only money outside that fund for new ventures.

ham.manh: You're not afraid of losing, so you dare to try ways of earning that others haven't dared.
ham.de_vap: You tend to spend on impulse — buying things then abandoning them, investing then pulling out in a hurry — and money drains away without a trace.
ham.loi_khuyen: Record every expense for a month, then cross out the three you regret most and cut them completely next month.

sang.manh: You have bounce; after spells of intense work you still recover if you actually rest.
sang.de_vap: You tend to live at high intensity — late nights, crammed work — and then crash all at once.
sang.loi_khuyen: Keep a fixed bedtime even when you're fired up about work, and have one day a week with nothing heavy.

ham.manh: You're willing to change habits when you see the need, so starting a new routine isn't hard for you.
ham.de_vap: Your daily rhythm easily turns upside down — early to bed one day, up all night the next, irregular meals.
ham.loi_khuyen: Keep at least one fixed anchor each day, like breakfast time or bedtime, even when other things change.

sang.manh: Out in the world you adapt quickly; new environments energise you, suiting work that involves a lot of travel or moving around.
sang.de_vap: You tend to keep moving on, changing places constantly before you've had time to build relationships.
sang.loi_khuyen: At each place you've worked, stay in touch with at least two people after you leave.

ham.manh: You dare to leave the familiar to seek opportunities, and many people admire that courage.
ham.de_vap: Out in the world you can run into surprises because you go and decide in a hurry, without preparing properly.
ham.loi_khuyen: Before each trip or job change, make a preparation checklist and go over it again the night before.

sang.manh: You have different circles of friends for each stage of life, and each gives you fresh perspectives.
sang.de_vap: You tend to let old friends drift away as you move into a new stage, then feel the gap when you need them.
sang.loi_khuyen: Each quarter, message an old friend you haven't been in touch with for a long time.

ham.manh: You dare to leave groups of friends that no longer suit you, rather than staying out of politeness.
ham.de_vap: Relationships with friends and colleagues can be turbulent: partnerships that fall apart, joint investments that don't split amicably.
ham.loi_khuyen: For every partnership with friends, agree from the start both how to begin and how to stop.

sang.manh: You suit work that needs innovation: start-ups, restructuring, technology — places that need someone willing to drop the old way.
sang.de_vap: You tend to want to change jobs or projects halfway through, leaving many things unfinished.
sang.loi_khuyen: For each project, set a minimum milestone you must reach before allowing yourself to change direction.

ham.manh: You can handle unstable periods at work and know how to adapt when everything changes.
ham.de_vap: Work changes constantly; switching careers many times makes it hard for you to build deep experience.
ham.loi_khuyen: Choose one core skill to pursue for at least three years, and carry it with you even when you change workplaces.

sang.manh: You know how to make an old home new and enjoy renovating and rearranging so it suits each stage of life.
sang.de_vap: You tend to renovate or move many times, spending money without really settling down.
sang.loi_khuyen: Before each renovation or move, write down the reasons and the cost, wait a month, and see whether you still want it.

ham.manh: You can live in many different places without discomfort.
ham.de_vap: Your living situation tends to be unsettled — things breaking, clutter — or you haven't yet found a place you want to stay long.
ham.loi_khuyen: Keep a small monthly fund for home repairs, and fix broken things within the week instead of letting them pile up.

sang.manh: You feel most alive when creating something new — a personal project, something handmade.
sang.de_vap: You find it hard to be content with what you have, always feeling that something needs changing.
sang.loi_khuyen: Keep a small creative project outside work, like drawing, writing or woodwork, so your urge to renew has an outlet.

ham.manh: You're not afraid of starting over, and that's a strength when life gets turbulent.
ham.de_vap: Inside you often feel restless, rarely content with the present, and easily give up things that are going well.
ham.loi_khuyen: Before giving up something you have, write down three things it gives you every day, then decide.

sang.manh: You think differently from your parents and can help your family refresh outdated habits.
sang.de_vap: You and your parents or boss easily see things differently: you want change, they want to keep things as they are.
sang.loi_khuyen: When you want to change something at home, propose trying it for a month instead of changing it outright.

ham.manh: You're independent, rarely relying on your parents or superiors, and take care of your own path.
ham.de_vap: Relationships with your parents or boss can crack at times because you act on your own without telling them first.
ham.loi_khuyen: Before doing something big that goes against your parents' or boss's wishes, let them know with a word in advance, even if they don't agree yet.

Liêm Trinh.loi_khuyen: Find ways to let off stress, like sport or talking things over; have regular blood tests and heart check-ups.

Thiên Phủ.bo_phan: the stomach, digestion and body weight
Thiên Phủ.thoi_quen: Eating a lot when you're happy, sitting for long periods and moving little.
Thiên Phủ.loi_khuyen: Eat slowly, cut down on fatty and sugary food, walk after meals and have regular digestive check-ups.

Thái Âm.bo_phan: the kidneys, sleep, the eyes and the hormonal system
Thái Âm.thoi_quen: Staying up late, brooding at night, and letting your feelings affect how you eat and sleep.
Thái Âm.loi_khuyen: Switch off screens well before bedtime, keep your body warm, and have regular eye and hormone check-ups.

Tham Lang.bo_phan: the liver, the kidneys and reproductive health
Tham Lang.thoi_quen: Going out, drinking and staying up late for the fun of it.
Tham Lang.loi_khuyen: Cut down on alcohol, sleep before midnight, and have your liver and kidneys checked regularly.

Cự Môn.bo_phan: the mouth, throat, teeth and digestion
Cự Môn.thoi_quen: Talking a lot, holding grudges and eating in a hurry.
Cự Môn.loi_khuyen: Drink warm water, look after your voice when you have to talk a lot, and have regular dental and digestive check-ups.

Thiên Tướng.bo_phan: the skin, the urinary tract and the excretory system
Thiên Tướng.thoi_quen: Looking after other people's business before your own, and not drinking water when busy.
Thiên Tướng.loi_khuyen: Set reminders to drink water, care for your skin in dry weather, and have regular urinary check-ups.

Thiên Lương.thoi_quen: Worrying about others, carrying their worries yourself, and skipping meals while helping someone.
Thiên Lương.loi_khuyen: Eat on time, share some of your worries with family, and have regular digestive and chest check-ups.

Thất Sát.bo_phan: the lungs, breathing, bones, joints and muscles
Thất Sát.thoi_quen: Working in bursts, bumping into things because you move fast, and rarely warming up before hard exercise.
Thất Sát.loi_khuyen: Warm up properly before exercise, keep good posture when lifting, and have regular respiratory and joint check-ups.

Phá Quân.bo_phan: the kidneys, the urinary tract, the bowels, bones and joints
Phá Quân.thoi_quen: Constantly changing your routine, eating and sleeping irregularly whenever something new comes up.
Phá Quân.loi_khuyen: Keep regular meal and sleep times even when work changes, drink enough water, and have regular kidney and digestive check-ups.

sat.thoi_quen: You easily overdo it, rush and so bump into things or twist an ankle, and only rest once you're completely worn out.
sat.loi_khuyen: Slow down when driving, cooking or using sharp tools; when you feel tired, stop right away instead of pushing to finish.

suc_khoe.chung: These are care suggestions from the old books, not a substitute for a doctor — if you notice anything unusual, get it checked.
suc_khoe.vo_chinh_dieu: When your health picture has no clear highlight, how well you feel depends a lot on your surroundings and daily habits, so keeping regular eating and sleeping is the best care.

Kình Dương.thoi_quen: You tend to work fast and get hasty with knives, scissors or behind the wheel.
Kình Dương.loi_khuyen: When you're in a hurry, slow down in the kitchen and on the road; keep a first-aid kit at home and in the car.

Đà La.thoi_quen: You tend to let tiredness drag on, and unfinished business keeps you from sleeping well.
Đà La.loi_khuyen: Each evening, write down three unfinished things for tomorrow before bed, so your mind can rest.

Hỏa Tinh.thoi_quen: You easily run hot inside when stressed, and eat spicy food or drink on impulse.
Hỏa Tinh.loi_khuyen: Drink enough water and cut down on spicy food and alcohol during high-pressure weeks.

Linh Tinh.thoi_quen: You tend to worry in silence; stress builds up without being spoken, and sleep gets hard.
Linh Tinh.loi_khuyen: When you've slept badly for a few nights in a row, tell someone you trust what's worrying you and practise slow breathing before bed.

Địa Không.thoi_quen: You tend to skip meals and live irregularly when absorbed in work or in thought.
Địa Không.loi_khuyen: Set phone reminders for lunch and bedtime, even on busy days.

Địa Kiếp.thoi_quen: You easily overdo it for a short spell and then run completely out of steam.
Địa Kiếp.loi_khuyen: Break big tasks into parts, and stop at a fixed time each day even if it's not finished.
