Mệnh.can_bang: Ten years that shape your way of living — choose two or three core habits and keep them steady.
Mệnh.can_chu_dong: Ten years in which you push yourself too hard — set fewer goals and get feedback before big decisions.
Mệnh.tuoi_nho: Childhood is when personality takes shape; the adults around should notice what the child genuinely enjoys.

Huynh Đệ.nen_lam: Work with people you trust and look after your bond with your siblings.
Huynh Đệ.de_vap: It's easy to get tangled in shared money matters with relatives.
Huynh Đệ.thuan: A good time to join forces with siblings or close friends on a shared project.
Huynh Đệ.can_bang: Keep in regular touch with your siblings; write down any shared money matters.
Huynh Đệ.can_chu_dong: Avoid putting money in jointly or co-signing with relatives without clear paperwork.
Huynh Đệ.tuoi_nho: Childhood is tied to siblings and playmates — learning to share and keep your word.

Phu Thê.nen_lam: Make time for the person beside you and for the things you've agreed together.
Phu Thê.de_vap: It's easy to let your own affairs crowd out life as a couple.
Phu Thê.thuan: A good time to build your life as a couple — take on a big plan together, or meet someone who suits you if you're single.
Phu Thê.can_bang: Keep time just for the two of you, and divide the housework clearly.
Phu Thê.can_chu_dong: The two of you can fall out of step — set aside one evening a week to talk, and discuss big things before acting.
Phu Thê.tuoi_nho: During school years, this is the time to learn how to be a friend and how to treat others.

Tử Nữ.nen_lam: Spend time raising your children or mentoring young people.
Tử Nữ.de_vap: It's easy to worry about your children so much that you forget to look after yourself.
Tử Nữ.thuan: A good time to put energy into the next generation — children, grandchildren or the young people you mentor.
Tử Nữ.can_bang: Keep fixed time for your children or the young people you mentor, and let them do what they can manage on their own.
Tử Nữ.can_chu_dong: Your children can worry you a lot — hear them out fully before giving advice, and keep some energy for yourself.
Tử Nữ.tuoi_nho: In childhood, it's good to play with younger children and look after a pet or a plant, to learn to care for others.

Tài Bạch.nen_lam: Look for ways to increase your income and make a clear savings plan.
Tài Bạch.de_vap: It's easy to chase money and forget to rest.
Tài Bạch.thuan: A good time to open new sources of income and build up savings for the long term.
Tài Bạch.can_bang: Keep income and spending steady, and save a fixed share every month.
Tài Bạch.can_chu_dong: Money can run short — keep a six-month emergency fund, and don't borrow to invest.
Tài Bạch.tuoi_nho: During school years, practise managing pocket money and knowing what's worth buying.

Tật Ách.chu_de: health and the rhythm of daily life
Tật Ách.nen_lam: Build habits of regular eating and sleeping, steady exercise and regular check-ups.
Tật Ách.de_vap: It's easy to overexert yourself because you think you're still strong.
Tật Ách.thuan: A good time to build a lasting exercise habit while your energy is plentiful.
Tật Ách.can_bang: Keep regular sleep and meals and have a check-up every year.
Tật Ách.can_chu_dong: Your energy drains easily — cut back on overtime, rest as soon as tiredness lingers, and keep your check-up appointments.
Tật Ách.tuoi_nho: In childhood, good eating and sleeping habits and outdoor play lay the foundation for later health.

Thiên Di.nen_lam: Branch out: change jobs, study more, meet new people.
Thiên Di.de_vap: It's easy to feel unsettled when you're away from familiar places.
Thiên Di.thuan: A good time to study away from home, take a job somewhere new or widen your circle of contacts.
Thiên Di.can_bang: Go out into the world in measured steps — try new places but keep one familiar place to come back to.
Thiên Di.can_chu_dong: Going out into the world can feel unsteady — sort out paperwork and housing carefully before moving, and don't change too many things at once.
Thiên Di.tuoi_nho: In childhood, it's good to take trips, go to summer camp and get used to new places with adults.

Nô Bộc.nen_lam: Build a good working team and choose friends carefully.
Nô Bộc.de_vap: It's easy to wear yourself out helping people in the wrong places.
Nô Bộc.thuan: A good time to build a team, hire people or take a role leading others.
Nô Bộc.can_bang: Keep a few good relationships, and help people within your means.
Nô Bộc.can_chu_dong: You can be drained by other people — choose your collaborators carefully and always write down money matters with friends.
Nô Bộc.tuoi_nho: During school years, choosing playmates and practising teamwork.

Quan Lộc.chu_de: career and your standing in your field
Quan Lộc.nen_lam: Put your energy into your expertise and take on tasks with clear responsibility.
Quan Lộc.de_vap: It's easy to get swept up in work and miss family moments.
Quan Lộc.thuan: A good time to take on a bigger role or put your energy into what you do best and deliver results.
Quan Lộc.can_bang: Do your main job solidly and learn one new skill each year.
Quan Lộc.can_chu_dong: Work brings a lot of pressure — keep a stable job and learn one back-up skill each year.
Quan Lộc.tuoi_nho: During school years, focus on studying and try many subjects to discover what you enjoy.

Điền Trạch.nen_lam: Sort out where you live and build up property for the long term.
Điền Trạch.de_vap: It's easy to borrow beyond your means because you want a home quickly.
Điền Trạch.thuan: A good time to secure a long-term home, renovate or build up property.
Điền Trạch.can_bang: Arrange housing within your means, and renovate bit by bit rather than all at once.
Điền Trạch.can_chu_dong: Home matters can get expensive — don't borrow beyond your means, and only pay once the paperwork is clear.
Điền Trạch.tuoi_nho: Childhood is tied to family routines; moving less often lets a child study more calmly.

Phúc Đức.chu_de: inner life and the wider family
Phúc Đức.nen_lam: Look after your own joys, keep the family's ways and protect your sleep.
Phúc Đức.de_vap: It's easy to keep dwelling on old matters among relatives.
Phúc Đức.thuan: A good time to nurture your inner life, stay close to relatives and keep up a long-term hobby.
Phúc Đức.can_bang: Keep the family's ways and a hobby of your own so your mind can rest.
Phúc Đức.can_chu_dong: Your mind can feel heavy — carry fewer of your relatives' troubles, and have a phone-free break every day.
Phúc Đức.tuoi_nho: In childhood, it's good to be close to grandparents, hear family stories and learn the family's ways.

Phụ Mẫu.nen_lam: Learn from those who came before you and stay close to your parents.
Phụ Mẫu.de_vap: It's easy to clash with elders because you think differently.
Phụ Mẫu.thuan: A good time to study, sit exams, sort out paperwork and learn from those ahead of you.
Phụ Mẫu.can_bang: Stay close to your parents, and get paperwork done on time.
Phụ Mẫu.can_chu_dong: You can clash with elders or get stuck in red tape — reason gently, and check every document twice.
Phụ Mẫu.tuoi_nho: During school years, the main job is studying and listening to teachers and parents.

Mệnh.nhan: guard your energy and keep your word

tre.y: You tend to take on many things at once, then get annoyed with yourself when they aren't done.
tre.tranh: taking on extra work just because you find it hard to say no, staying up late for weeks on end to keep up
tre.lam: choose two main goals for the whole year and keep one full day off each week

lon.y: You tire more easily than you think and tend to keep your worries to yourself.
lon.tranh: taking on other people's share of the work, putting off your regular health check-up
lon.lam: get a health check-up at the start of the year, and each month share one worry with someone close

Tài Bạch.nhan: keep a tight hold on money

tre.y: Money comes and goes unevenly; unexpected expenses tend to arrive just when you've spent a lot.
tre.tranh: consumer loans, buying things you don't need yet on instalments, investing just because friends ask you to join in
tre.lam: set aside enough to live on for three months and write down every expense above a fixed amount

lon.y: Money can get tangled because of other people: loans that are hard to get back, money paperwork that isn't clear.
lon.tranh: acting as a guarantor, lending large sums with no paperwork, putting all your money in one place
lon.lam: keep a six-month emergency fund, and put every loan in writing with both signatures

tre.y: At work, misunderstandings with your manager come easily, or it isn't clear who is responsible for which task.
tre.tranh: quitting in anger, jumping ship before you have a job offer in hand
tre.lam: follow up any verbal assignment with a short written summary, and learn an extra skill to fall back on

lon.y: Work can slow down and mistakes get picked on; your role may change against your wishes.
lon.tranh: changing business direction in a hurry, expanding before you have enough people, signing big contracts you haven't fully read
lon.lam: keep your work files in order, and have someone you trust reread contracts before you sign

Phu Thê.nhan: keep the peace with the one you love

tre.y: The two of you can misunderstand each other over wishes left unspoken.
tre.tranh: making big decisions about the two of you while angry, secretly checking each other's phones
tre.lam: spend one evening a week talking without phones, and say clearly what you hope for

lon.y: Married life can get tense over shared money, housework or the children's schooling.
lon.tranh: raising your voice in front of the children, hiding a large sum of money from each other
lon.lam: sit down once a month to go over shared money, and divide the housework into clear parts

tre.y: Where you live can bring problems: having to move, renovations, or housemates who don't get along.
tre.tranh: putting down a deposit on a home before checking the paperwork, signing a long lease in a hurry
tre.lam: read the lease carefully and keep money ready for one move

lon.y: Home and land take extra effort: slow paperwork, repairs that run over budget.
lon.tranh: buying or selling property in a hurry, holding property in your name for someone else, major building work before you have the money
lon.lam: sort out the property papers first, and renovate one budgeted item at a time

Mệnh.nhan: take more care when you're out and about
Mệnh.y: Things outside the home, long trips or meeting strangers can leave you tired and frazzled.
Mệnh.tranh: agreeing to long trips at the last minute, trusting the promises of people you've just met
Mệnh.lam: plan your travel early, bring all your papers, and meet new people in busy places

Tài Bạch.y: You may worry about money even when nothing has happened, then decide in a hurry because of the worry.
Tài Bạch.tranh: chasing get-rich-quick schemes, buying or selling while you're restless
Tài Bạch.lam: write down your real income and spending figures, and wait a week before any big decision

Quan Lộc.y: Love or family matters can drag your worries over into your work.
Quan Lộc.tranh: bringing arguments into the workplace, going into business with your partner before it's clear who owns what
Quan Lộc.lam: keep work hours and home hours separate, and write down each person's share of any joint money

Phu Thê.nhan: busy at work, don't neglect the one you love
Phu Thê.y: High-pressure work can make you distant with the one you love without you noticing.
Phu Thê.tranh: cancelling plans again and again because of work, taking your frustrations from work out on your family
Phu Thê.lam: keep one fixed shared meal each day, and let them know in advance whenever you'll be home late

Điền Trạch.nhan: home costs coming from people in the household
Điền Trạch.y: Matters involving the children or younger people at home can bring costs for the house.
Điền Trạch.tranh: moving or renovating on a passing whim, lending a large sum to a family member without discussing it first
Điền Trạch.lam: talk every housing expense over with the whole family, and keep a separate fund for repairs

Mệnh.y: You have energy and people notice you; what you suggest is easily heard.
Mệnh.lam: choose one big goal to put your energy into, and accept study or partnership offers that suit you

Tài Bạch.y: Money comes in more easily, with extra income from the very thing you do well.
Tài Bạch.lam: open one small extra source of income and set some aside straight away whenever a large sum comes in

Quan Lộc.nhan: good for moving ahead at work
Quan Lộc.y: Work brings a chance at a new role or a project worth doing.
Quan Lộc.lam: take on a hard task you can handle, and ask for a raise once you have results to show

Phu Thê.y: Love runs more smoothly; if you're single, it's easier to meet someone who suits you.
Phu Thê.lam: talk about your future together, and accept invitations to meet people your friends introduce

Điền Trạch.y: A good time for housing: buying, renovating or rearranging the home all go smoothly.
Điền Trạch.lam: do the home project you've long planned, and check the paperwork carefully before you pay

ky.nhan: your child should take it slower

Mệnh.nhan: your child needs enough sleep and play
Mệnh.y: Your child tires and gets irritable easily, and keeps sadness to themselves.
Mệnh.tranh: filling your child's schedule with extra classes, scolding them when they're tired
Mệnh.lam: keep your child's sleep hours sufficient, and each evening ask them about one happy and one sad thing from their day

Tài Bạch.nhan: your child learns to manage pocket money
Tài Bạch.y: Your child may spend everything on toys or online games, or be talked into joint purchases by friends.
Tài Bạch.tranh: giving your child a payment card with no limit, replacing everything they lose
Tài Bạch.lam: give your child a fixed weekly allowance and write down together where it went

Quan Lộc.nhan: go easy on your child's studies
Quan Lộc.y: Your child can feel pressure over grades or clash with a teacher after a misunderstanding.
Quan Lộc.tranh: piling on more extra classes, comparing your child's grades with their classmates'
Quan Lộc.lam: meet the form teacher once at the start of the year, and help your child break schoolwork into small parts

Phu Thê.nhan: your child needs someone to listen about friends
Phu Thê.y: Your child may be upset over a close friend, and sometimes hides from you that they've been left out.
Phu Thê.tranh: banning your child from seeing a friend without asking why, secretly reading their messages
Phu Thê.lam: invite your child's close friend over to play, and ask about their friends with curiosity, not interrogation

Điền Trạch.nhan: home is changing, your child needs time to adjust
Điền Trạch.y: Moving house, changing schools or a new person in the home can unsettle your child.
Điền Trạch.tranh: changing schools mid-year without telling your child in advance
Điền Trạch.lam: tell your child about any change in where you live ahead of time, and keep a study corner just for them

loc.nhan: a good year for your child

Mệnh.nhan: a year your child grows fast, happy and healthy
Mệnh.y: Your child is healthy, happy and easily liked by everyone.
Mệnh.lam: let your child try a sport or talent they enjoy

Tài Bạch.nhan: a good time to teach your child about money
Tài Bạch.y: Your child grasps money matters easily and knows how to save.
Tài Bạch.lam: give your child a piggy bank or small savings book, and pick something to save up for together

Quan Lộc.nhan: a year your child takes to studying
Quan Lộc.y: Your child takes to studying more, and is easily noticed and given tasks by teachers.
Quan Lộc.lam: let your child take on a role in class, and praise exactly what they did well

Phu Thê.nhan: a year your child makes good friends
Phu Thê.y: Your child easily makes good close friends and learns a lot from them.
Phu Thê.lam: arrange outings for your child with a group of friends, with an adult keeping an eye on them

Điền Trạch.nhan: a calm year at home for your child
Điền Trạch.y: Home is settled, and your child has a stable place to study and play.
Điền Trạch.lam: rearrange your child's study corner together, the way they like it

nam_tuoi.y: Folk custom says that in your animal year you should keep to your routines and not start many big things at once.
nam_tuoi.tranh: doing several big things in the same year
nam_tuoi.lam: choose the single biggest task to do carefully, and get a health check-up at the start of the year

xung_tuoi.y: Folk belief sees a clash year as a year of changes: moving, changing jobs, travelling far.
xung_tuoi.tranh: changing many things at the same time
xung_tuoi.lam: change things one at a time, and keep one old routine to lean on

va_tuoi.y: Folk belief sees this as a year of small run-ins with the people around you.

tam_tai.y: By custom, during the three consecutive years of this spell, big plans should be thought through more carefully.
tam_tai.tranh: rushing to start building, marrying or opening a business just because you found an auspicious date, without being prepared
tam_tai.lam: plan your money for all three years, and talk big plans through carefully with your family
